subjects.displayTitle: Presence and reunion: the distance the heart can cross
subjects.introduction: Jacob, a thousand leagues away, catches the scent of Joseph’s garment, while those who carry it smell nothing. Bahá’u’lláh opens the matter of presence with that reversal: the far draw near and the near stay remote, because what crosses the distance is recognition and love. God’s Essence remains beyond every eye, yet to attain the presence of the Manifestation is to attain the presence of God. Around that teaching gather the memories of real journeys: a voice heard at the door of the prison in ‘Akká, a visitor told that teaching the Word would please God more than a second pilgrimage, and the assurance to those who longed to come but could not that their desire is itself counted as arrival. Philip’s request to see the Father, and the Qur’án’s binding of the hope of meeting one’s Lord to righteous work, approach the same longing from other directions. The way continues toward nearness to God, the self’s passing away and abiding, and the transformation a cherished encounter asks of a life afterwards.
subjects.arc: Open with nearness beyond distance; clarify recognition and divine transcendence; follow longing through prayer and actual encounters; consider exclusion, remembered presence and reunion beyond death; return to service as the fruit of meeting.

order.why: Clarify meeting through the Manifestations.
shortened: The knowledge of Him, Who is the Origin of all things, and attainment unto Him, are impossible save through knowledge of, and attainment unto, these luminous Beings who proceed from the Sun of Truth. By attaining, therefore, to the presence of these holy Luminaries, the "Presence of God" Himself is attained.

order.why: Open with distant Jacob perceiving what nearby people miss.
Reassure a person far from the Shrine.
shortened:
O Amata'l-Baha! Think not that because thou art away from the Blessed
Shrine, thou art distant and in a forlorn state. Thou art present and visible.

order.why: Connect remembered presence with being seen.
shortened: By God! Whenever thou rememberest thy merciful Lord, verily He is present before thy face, and though thou seest Him not, He verily seeth thee.

order.why: Let care persist even without the seeker’s recognition.
shortened: If thou seest Him, then blessed art thou, and if thou seest Him not, verily He seeth thee. If thou knowest Him, thine eyes are gladdened, and if thou knowest Him not, yet He knoweth thee in thy turning and thy resting-place, and He is never heedless of thee nor will He forget thee. He heareth thy cry and thy whispered prayer.

order.why: Ask the heart to draw near.
Name faith and intention as the foundation of nearness.
Keep divine invisibility within the account of manifestation.
Distinguish beholding the Essence from meeting its Manifestation.
Read the Bab’s account of the path to presence.
Hear the testimony of recognition in visitation.
shortened: I bear witness that he who hath known Thee hath known God, and he who hath attained unto Thy presence hath attained unto the presence of God.

order.why: Retain the equivalent testimony of reunion.
Connect turning toward Him with affirming unity.
shortened: Whoso turneth unto Him hath turned unto My Face and been illumined by the lights of My Beauty and acknowledged My unity and confessed My singleness.

order.why: Keep the reported comparison of prophetic revelation attributed.
shortened: Consequently God revealed Himself to Moses through the burning bush, to Christ through the Holy Spirit and to Mohamad through Gabriel. These different names mean one thing.

order.why: Affirm oneness within the inquiry into meeting.
Connect knowledge with attaining presence.
shortened: Whoso in this luminous Day hath quaffed from the Kawthar of divine knowledge hath attained unto the presence of God and is accounted among the people of certitude in the Perspicuous Book, and shall be adorned with the ornament of acceptance throughout all the divine worlds.

order.why: Explains scriptural references to attaining the presence of God.
Read recognition as an enduring life of knowledge.
shortened: That life, however, which is mentioned in the Books of the Prophets and the Chosen Ones of God is the life of knowledge; that is to say, the servant's recognition of the sign of the splendours wherewith He Who is the Source of all splendour hath Himself invested him, and his certitude of attaining unto the presence of God through the Manifestations of His Cause. This is that blessed and everlasting life that perisheth not: whosoever is quickened thereby shall never die, but will endure as long as His Lord and Creator will endure.

order.why: Consider knowing and meeting as creation’s purpose.
shortened: The purpose of God in creating man hath been, and will ever be, to enable him to know his Creator and to attain His Presence. To this most excellent aim, this supreme objective, all the heavenly Books and the divinely revealed and weighty Scriptures unequivocally bear witness.

order.why: Receive the same purpose through the creative Word.
shortened: Therefore, all servants have been created for the meeting and knowledge of God, and have come into being through the Word "Be."

order.why: Hear the call to the station for which people were created.
shortened: You were all created to attain His presence and to stand in that most mighty and most great station. He shall send down from the heaven of His generosity that which is best for you, and that which He hath sent down from His presence shall make you independent of all the worlds.

order.why: Join guidance, nearness and honor.
Explore the claim of presence within oneself.
shortened: And whosoever attaineth unto this station hath attained unto the presence of God within his own self, by his own self.

order.why: Follow the inmost heart toward enduring contemplation.
Let the heart become a dwelling through sanctification.
Consider the removal of the veil through grace.
Hear the proclamation of the Promised One’s voice and face.
shortened: Verily I say, this is the Day in which mankind can behold the Face, and hear the Voice, of the Promised One. The Call of God hath been raised, and the light of His countenance hath been lifted up upon men.

order.why: Receive the Day through thanksgiving.
shortened: Magnified be Thy name, O my God, for that Thou hast manifested the Day which is the King of Days, the Day which Thou didst announce unto Thy chosen Ones and Thy Prophets in Thy most excellent Tablets, the Day whereon Thou didst shed the splendor of the glory of all Thy names upon all created things. Great is his blessedness whosoever hath set himself towards Thee, and entered Thy presence, and caught the accents of Thy voice.

order.why: Retain its proclaimed uniqueness.
Ask what kind of hearing and sight the Day requires.
Read love’s wings as spiritual nearness.
Hear the glad tidings addressed to all.
Hold the Day of witnessing beside human sleep.
shortened: This is the Day of witnessing and meeting, yet most of the people are fast asleep.

order.why: Receive the promise of meeting in revealed verses.
shortened: These are the verses of immortality wherein are contained the mysteries of God, the Protector, the Mighty, the All-Knowing. Therein is mentioned that which gives glad tidings unto men of the meeting with their Lord on the Day when all who are in the realm of being shall be gathered together.

order.why: Remember the hope of the chosen and pure.
Keep creation’s yearning for the Manifestation.
shortened: All creation has hoped and yearned to attain the presence of the Manifestation of Revelation, which is identical with attaining the presence of God.

order.why: Let eyes, ears, tongues and hearts respond together.
Hear the Speaker of the Mount in the present call.
shortened: Today the Speaker of the Mount is speaking. Blessed is the ear that hath been honored by His call and the eye that hath beheld His signs.

order.why: Listen to the Lote-Tree calling between worlds.
shortened: Blessed is he who hath inclined his ear unto the Divine Lote-Tree which calleth betwixt the worlds, and blessed the eye that hath beheld this noble scene.

order.why: Bless the hearing and seeing that attain.
Keep the paired hearer and seer.
shortened: Blessed is the hearer who hath on this day won victory through the call of the Self-Subsisting, and blessed is the seer who hath turned unto the Dayspring of lights.

order.why: Notice signs of favor in every direction.
shortened: The signs of the favors of God, exalted be His glory, are manifest and evident from every direction, and the effulgences of the lights of His Revelation are sanctified and holy beyond all else.

order.why: Attend to the proclamation of a human form.
shortened: Deprive not thyself of the grace which hath preceded all created things and for whose appearance the Temples of the Cause waited in centuries past. Say: He hath appeared in human form.

order.why: Read relationships through the Day’s spiritual purpose.
shortened: All earthly ties are severed this day, for it is the Day of revelation and meeting, and all relationships return to the Truth Himself.

order.why: Hold fast amid the rending of veils.
shortened: O Rida! Hold thou fast to the Sure Handle and cling to the hem of the grace of the Lord of all humanity. Today the Great News hath appeared and the Truth, exalted be His glory, hath rent asunder the veils of majesty.

order.why: Ask what sovereignty is worth without a moment of mercy.
shortened: By Thy glory, O my Beloved! Even shouldst Thou give me all that Thou hast created and shalt create, and make me sovereign over all who dwell in the kingdom of Thy Cause and creation, and seat me upon the throne of grandeur and power and the seat of loftiness and independence, yet deny me the sweet fragrances of Thy mercy and the breezes of Thy bounty for less than a moment - by Thy glory, my soul would not be content, my heart would not find peace, and my spirit would find no rest.

order.why: Follow tasted nearness into longing.
Hear the anguish of separation in prayer.
shortened: My God, my God! Thy separation hath caused me to perish. Where is the light of Thy presence, O Illuminator of the world? The venom of remoteness from Thee hath destroyed me. Where is the fountain of Thy reunion, O Quickener of nations?

order.why: Bring lamentation and reunion into one invocation.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the wondrous dawning rays of the light of Thy Beauty, and the manifestations of the glory of Thy sovereignty and majesty, and by the lamentation of them that yearn for Thee in their separation and remoteness from Thee, and by the cry of them that love Thee at the appearance of the Sun of Thy reunion and presence.

order.why: Compare the fire of separation with reunion’s water.
shortened: Thou knowest that the fire of separation cannot be quenched save by the waters of Thy reunion and presence, and their agitation cannot be stilled except by beholding Thy beauty.

order.why: Seek what can quench that particular thirst.
shortened: By God! Nothing shall profit you this Day though ye should cling to all things, and naught shall quench your thirst of separation save the water of reunion that floweth from the spring of your Lord's bounty, the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful.

order.why: Join thirst and spiritual life.
Let tears and sighs express the desire to meet.
shortened: O God, my God! My tears are flowing, my sighs are protracted, and my distress hath intensified by reason of my yearning to meet Thee and my attraction to Thy kingdom.

order.why: Hear yearning for face, light and heavenly music.
shortened: O Thou my Desired One! How I long to attain to Thy radiant meeting! O Thou my Hope! How I yearn to look into Thy luminous Countenance! How I crave to be submerged in the sea of Thy refulgent Lights! How I strain my ears to listen to the invisible, soft music of the angels of Thy supreme concourse!

order.why: Pray as one who has left home for another abode.
shortened: I am the one, O my God, who hath left his abode, turning toward Thy abode. Thou hearest the lamentation of my heart in my separation from Thee and my yearning to meet Thee.

order.why: Follow the attraction of verses into searching.
Keep the intimate language of mutual solace.
Answer separation through the ocean of presence.
shortened: The fire of thy separation from Me was fast consuming thee, when the ocean of My presence surged before thy face, cheering thine eyes and those of all creation, and filling with delight all things visible and invisible.

order.why: Receive the assurance that nearness is loved.
Hear a call answered with consolation.
shortened: We have heard the call of those who have turned toward God and have answered them with that which causeth eyes to be consoled.

order.why: Read a spoken word transforming separation into union.
Let solitude open toward companionship.
Begin prayer with awareness of presence.
Practice remembrance morning and evening.
Listen again for a melody that draws near.
shortened: Then hearken, O My handmaiden, unto My sweetest melodies once again, that they may purify thee from all else besides Me and draw thee nigh unto My presence and bring thee to My dawning-place wherein the lights of My beauty have shone forth from the direction of My throne.

order.why: Attend to the rustling that leads toward God.
shortened: O thou who hast turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon! Hearken unto the rustling of the Divine Lote Tree. Verily it draweth thee nigh unto God, the Lord of the worlds.

order.why: Explore inner meanings as an ocean.
shortened: O servant! Hearken unto the call of the Lord of Names, then immerse thyself in the ocean of inner meanings and divine knowledge, that thou mayest behold what thou hast never beheld before and discover therein the pearls of thy Lord's remembrance, the Mighty, the Bestower.

order.why: Let receiving new understanding deepen day by day.
Pray not to be turned from the city’s gate.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O my God, by Thy mighty Sign, and by the revelation of Thy grace amongst men, to cast me not away from the gate of the city of Thy presence, and to disappoint not the hopes I have set on the manifestations of Thy grace amidst Thy creatures.

order.why: Ask to roam the meadows of nearness.
shortened: Within the meadows of Thy nearness, before Thy presence, make me able to roam, O my Beloved, and at the right hand of the throne of Thy mercy seat me, O my Desire!

order.why: Let the Bab’s prayer bring fear into trust and hope.
Seek steadfastness while turning toward the countenance.
Ask for ascent toward the station of beholding.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst manifest Thy Beauty, perfect Thy Cause, exalt Thy proof, elevate Thy names and reveal Thy attributes, that Thou mayest cause Thy servants to ascend unto the station wherein they behold Thee upon the throne of Thy majesty and the seat of Thy glory.

order.why: Approach the offered chalice.
shortened: Send down, then, upon me, O my Lord, out of the heaven of Thy bounty what will draw me nearer unto the chalice of Thy gifts, and make me able to quaff the choice sealed Wine, whose seal hath been loosed in Thy name, and from Which the sweet savors of Thy days have been shed abroad.

order.why: Speak as the distant, poor and thirsty.
shortened: When thou art attracted by the fragrances of My verses and seized by the Kawthar of Mine utterance, say: "My God, my God! Thou seest him who is remote seeking Thy nearness, and the poor one seeking the ocean of Thy riches, and the thirsty one seeking the Kawthar of Thy bounty.

order.why: Give longing the language of poverty and impermanence.
Pray for mercy upon the approaching seeker.
Seek nearness in every condition.
shortened: Then ordain for me, O my God, that which will draw me nigh unto Thee in all conditions. Verily, Thou art the Self-Sufficient, the Most High. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

order.why: Join attaining presence with remaining steadfast.
Ask to arrive at reunion’s shore.
Join the hope of meeting with Sinai’s call.
Pray to journey in the realms of nearness.
Let the ark of the self carry a prayer for all.
Ask not to be deprived in any world.
shortened: O my Lord! I have turned my face toward the Dayspring of the lights of Thy countenance. I beseech Thee not to deprive me of Thee in any world of Thy worlds.

order.why: Pray that others be taken by the hand.
shortened: Take them by the hands of Thy bounty, then cause them to enter the pavilion of reunion at the shining forth of the lights of Thy countenance.

Look upon them, then, with the glances of Thy loving-kindness, and make them to be among those who circle round the sanctuary of Thy oneness and who stand before the revelation of the lights of Thy face.

order.why: Hear the vulnerable questions of the thirsty seeker.
shortened: Wilt Thou cast away this evanescent one who hath sought the kingdom of Thine eternity, and wilt Thou deny this thirsty one who hath turned toward the ocean of Thy bounty?

order.why: Widen the petition to all created things.
Pray for those who seek the elevation of the divine Word.
shortened: I beseech Thee by that shore of the sea of Thy reunion whereon was raised the pavilion of Thy majesty and the tabernacle of Thy Cause, and where Thou didst manifest Thyself unto all who are on earth through the lights of Thy countenance, that Thou mayest exalt the stations of those who have desired the elevation of Thy Most Exalted Word and strengthen them to glorify Thy Cause, O Lord of Names and Creator of heaven!

order.why: Ask that all who turn receive the reward.
Treasure an encounter in prayer.
shortened: I beseech Thee to make this meeting a treasure for me in the repositories of Thy protection and a store for me with Thee.

order.why: Seek the portion ordained for the loved ones.
shortened: I have turned toward the horizon of Thy Manifestation, the ocean of Thy bounty and the sun of Thy grace. I beseech Thee not to disappoint me of that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones, Thy trusted ones and Thy loved ones.

order.why: Stand as a petitioner at the door.
shortened: O my Lord! I am he who has sought Thy nearness and Thy presence, to stand before Thy throne and at the door of Thy grandeur.

order.why: Pray to circle the divine will.
Seek beauty through its manifestations.
shortened: This is Thy servant who hath turned toward the realms of the sanctity of Thy divinity, and desired to enter the sanctuary of Thy Being and to gain admittance to the house of Thy oneness, that he might witness the subtleties of Thy beauty in the manifestations of Thine identity.

order.why: Receive reunion through bounty and grace.
Carry the prayer across every world.
Let the entire embodied person express devotion.
Read exclusive devotion in its prayerful setting.
shortened: For this is the station which Thou hast specially ordained for the sincere ones among Thy loved ones and the near ones among the people of Thy affection - they who behold none but Thee, who turn to none but Thee, who trust in none but Thee, who find intimacy with none save Thy beauty, who immerse themselves in naught but the seas of Thy good-pleasure, who breathe not except by Thy leave, and who speak not except by Thy command.

order.why: Follow remembrance into sleeping, walking and arising.
shortened: Sanctify thyself from all that veils thee from the beauty of the Divine Essence, in such wise that thou shalt dwell only in His remembrance, walk only in His name, sleep only by His leave, arise only at His bidding, drink only of His love, gaze only upon His beauty, seek only His presence, and desire only His meeting, that thou mayest enter the City of Immortality in the most exalted Paradise, attain unto every good, and find every light, and be in truth the guided one as thou art named.

order.why: Explore nearness through surrender of one’s will.
shortened: And whosoever attains to this station and causes his own will to be annihilated in the Will of God, has everlastingly been in nearness to the Eternal Presence.

order.why: Pray for release from self and passion.
shortened: Deliver Thy servants from the promptings of self and passion, that they may turn with their hearts unto Thee, hearken unto Thy call, and recognize that which Thou hast ordained for them through Thy bounty.

order.why: Soar through detachment.
shortened: Cast away all that ye possess and soar on the wings of detachment into this atmosphere wherein waft the breezes of the mercy of your Lord, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Generous."

order.why: Follow the handmaiden’s invitation through many realms.
Enter the crimson ark’s image of journey.
Retain the mysterious homeland beyond life and death.
shortened: He teacheth the servants from His resplendent, Most Glorious mysteries that people might hasten to the Kawthar of reunion in the refuges of piety and return to the homeland wherein none dieth nor liveth.

order.why: Read reunion as the lovers’ ultimate homeland.
shortened: This hath ever been and shall ever be the ultimate journey for those who seek, and the final homeland of the lovers.

order.why: Recognize the stated value of actual outward presence.
shortened: Though it is evident that no grace, bounty, station or rank can ever equal attaining the presence of God in the visible realm, I swear by the Sun of the glory of oneness, rising from the dawning-place of detachment in My Name, the All-Powerful, that nothing can equal appearing before the Throne in the visible realm, even for a moment, though one possessed all that is in the heavens and earth.

order.why: Hold outward meeting beside its inward worlds.
Remember entering a prison and hearing a voice.
Read the true Kaaba through a completed journey.
Give the journey its hardship and purpose.
shortened: The Supreme Pen testifies that you turned towards Him and, purely for the sake of God, set out from your home intending to reach the Most Great House of God. You bore the hardship of travel and traversed sea and land until you arrived at the Most Great Prison and heard His sweetest call and beheld His most exalted horizon.

order.why: Follow travel toward the opened gate.
Keep the visitor’s journey and later remembrance at his grave.
shortened: He traversed land and sea in his longing to attain the presence of God until he entered the shore of the right-hand valley in the blessed crimson spot.

Days passed, then We proceeded to the sepulcher, and when We arrived We stood before the grave and said: "O thou who didst race in the arena of the love of God! The fragrance of thy Lord's robe, the Lord of all names, stirred thee until thou didst seek the Most Exalted Horizon to attain the presence of the Throne and stand before the Gate.

order.why: Offer thanks for a particular traveler’s arrival.
shortened: O Lord! One of Your servants whom You gave to drink from Your sealed nectar and intoxicated from Your camphor cup, and made him recognize Your beauty in the day of Your manifestation, and made him yearn to arrive at the gate of Your favors, has crossed the deserts and wastes and valleys and seas and arrived before You and reached the courtyard of Your oneness and appeared before You, and You shone upon him with the lights of Your presence and illumined his eyes with the vision of Your beauty and honored him with listening and gladdened his heart with the radiance of Your luminous countenance.

order.why: Hear the testimony concerning a handmaiden’s departure from home.
Retain the journey across land and sea.
shortened: And We bear witness that thou didst leave thy homeland, seeking the homeland of God, and didst traverse land and sea in thy longing to attain His presence.

order.why: Join physical travel with the pearls of utterance.
Let heart and feet approach together.
shortened: He drew near with his heart and feet until he reached the paradise of Thy oneness and won the presence of the tree of Thy singleness before the sanctuary of Thy beauty. He sought Thy leave until he entered within the precincts of Thy mercy in the sanctuary of nearness and reunion with Thee, and heard the holy melodies in the highest paradise, and beheld the Beauty of the Divine Identity in the most exalted horizon, and reached such nearness that the clouds of Thy generosity and favor and the rain-clouds of Thy grace and bounty were showered upon him to a degree that none can reckon save Thee alone.

order.why: Give thanks for reaching what scripture promised.
shortened: O my God! Thou art He Who hath guided me through Thy bounty and aided me through Thy grace, until I departed from my home, seeking the ultimate goal and the supreme summit - the Station wherein was raised the screech of Thy Most Exalted Pen and the rustling of the Sadratu'l-Muntaha - until I attained Thy presence and heard and beheld that which was inscribed in Thy Book, recorded in Thy Scrolls, and treasured within the hearts of Thy Prophets.

order.why: Read the journey through covenant, piety and spiritual ascent.
Keep the prison’s discomfort beside inward bounty.
shortened: Although outwardly, due to prison conditions, things did not pass pleasantly for him, yet inwardly, praise and thanks be to God, he was blessed with the outpourings of the All-Merciful and attained that which is the ultimate goal - the presence of the Beloved of the worlds. This is truly a grace which serves as a luminous crown atop all deeds.

order.why: Remember an encounter at entry into the prison.
Hear the testimony of listening in confinement.
shortened: O thou who art present before the Wronged One! We testify that thou didst attain the presence of the Countenance and didst hear what the tongue of the Wronged One spoke forth in His mighty prison.

order.why: Retain the letter to a visitor in Akka.
Recall a visit with an uncle.
shortened: We make mention of those days when thou wert present with thy uncle - upon him be God's mercy and grace - before Our face, and ye both heard what the Tongue of Grandeur uttered in His mighty prison.

order.why: Keep named people within their particular movements.
shortened: Muhammad hath in these days been present before the Throne, and 'Ali is circling round, and Our servant Rahim and his other son are turning unto God.

order.why: Attend to the news of Nabil’s attainment.
Remember a son’s repeated visits.
shortened: Thy son, who hath been honored to attain the presence of God time and again and who hath been seized by the breathings of the days which were recorded in all the Tablets by the Pen of God, hath appeared before Us.

order.why: Extend the blessing to a family.
shortened: Blessed art thou, and blessed are thy father, thy mother, and thy brother who attained unto the presence of his Lord and quaffed the choice wine of reunion from the hands of the bounty of his Lord, the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful.

order.why: Give thanks for a brother’s hearing.
Recall an encounter in early life.
shortened: Blessed are you for having attained the presence of God in your early days and drunk the choice wine of reunion from the hands of the bounty of your Lord, the Generous.

order.why: Remember years of regular presence.
Let repeated daily and nightly meetings become explicit.
shortened: And therein We opened the gates of reunion to the faces of the loved ones, and gave all to drink from the ocean of Thy reunion and the springs of Thy nearness and good-pleasure, such that whoso desired was present each day before the throne of Thy mercy, and each night before Thy countenance, and in every moment there shone upon them the lights of Thy face and the suns of Thy grandeur and power.

order.why: Retain repeated visits and hearing.
Keep the counsel not to forget an open conversation.
Consider the value given to a brief remembered moment.
shortened: The days of attainment are surely remembered - a single moment's pause in the Desired Land cannot be equaled by centuries and ages.

order.why: Connect memory with keeping counsel.
Read detachment and humility at the throne.
Keep hearing and witnessing within the remembered visit.
Recognize turning amid widespread refusal.
Receive meeting as guidance and gift.
shortened: Through the wonders of His grace He guided thee to the Most Great Scene until thou didst attain unto His presence, drink from the cup of meeting, and without veil or barrier become illumined by the light of the countenance of the Beloved.

order.why: Keep arrival and departure under the stated command.
shortened: Thou art the one who entered the Most Great Scene by God's leave, the Possessor of Destiny, and departed from it by His command, the Mighty, the Wondrous.

order.why: Let a letter recall its writer’s encounter.
shortened: There hath come before Us a letter from one who hath turned towards My horizon, set his face towards My countenance, spoken My praise, appeared before My throne, and heard My call, and hath drunk the choice wine of reunion from the hands of My bounty.

order.why: Receive the blessing of having heard.
Remember circling, meeting and receiving.
shortened: We testify that thou didst circle round the Throne and didst attain the presence of thy Lord when most of mankind were debarred therefrom, and didst drink the pure wine from the hand of the bounty of thy Lord.

order.why: Keep the account of hearing with one’s own ear.
Join announcement and experienced reunion.
Read entry through torn veils.
shortened: Blessed is he who hath rent asunder the veils and entered the presence of his Lord, the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous, and hath drunk the most pure wine from the Supreme Horizon.

order.why: Keep the movement of turning and arriving.
Remember a visitor among those who attained.
shortened: Thou art indeed among those who have attained unto Him and His presence, and heard His call, and stood before the Throne after most of the servants were debarred therefrom.

order.why: Give thanks for the previous year’s encounter.
shortened: Blessed is he who hath attained His presence.
O servant! Give thanks unto God that in the previous year thou wast illumined by the Sun of Grandeur and attained the presence of the Spirit of God and wast honored to meet Him.

order.why: Read revelation through the received cup.
Let all things witness a person’s turning.
Connect hearing with forgiveness and a good end.
Join reunion’s water with knowledge of God.
Receive the blessing of the fountain.
Keep the testimony of seeking amid refusal.
Remember a woman’s meeting in the days of revelation.
shortened: She was honoured with attaining Thy presence in Thy days, and was enabled to behold Thy Beauty upon the horizon of Thy sanctity and in the kingdom of Thy oneness.

order.why: Receive attainment as grace.
shortened: He attained the presence of the Countenance, and the lights of Beauty shone upon Him from the Dayspring of Glory. Thus doth God single out whom He willeth through His grace, and He, verily, hath power over all things.

order.why: Keep the concise blessing of nearness.
Follow migration toward hearing.
Read the smiling lips of knowledge as gift.
Keep the testimony of a meeting in earthly life.
shortened: Thereupon doth the Tongue of Grandeur testify that thou didst turn unto the Face and didst respond to thy Lord when He called thee, and didst attain His presence in this earthly life, and didst hear with thine own ear His most mighty, most holy and wondrous call.

order.why: Bless the days of attainment.
Connect recognition, guidance and arrival.
Let the traveler’s arrival fulfill a stated purpose.
Read Javad’s response to the call.
Keep the blessing of turning by leave.
shortened: Blessed art thou for having attained the presence of the Beloved and for having turned to Him by His leave and heard His mighty and wondrous call.

order.why: Connect an opened gate with received utterance.
Give thanks for repeated hearing and holy refuge.
Gather hearing, recognition and a declaration of oneness.
Read the handmaiden’s ascent through servitude.
Let the command to rend imagined veils interrupt familiarity.
shortened: To reach the presence of Mulla Muhammad Ja'far that he may behold the Greatest Scene.

O Ja'far! Rend asunder the veils of idle fancy, for We have rent them by a sovereignty from Our presence and a power from Our side, and I am, verily, the One Who prevaileth over whatsoever I desire, the Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Ask why long expectation can miss an offered encounter.
Keep the account of expectant souls remaining deprived.
shortened: How many souls there were who waited expectantly for this Day and who, with utmost supplication and ardent desire, besought the All-Bountiful for His presence, and yet were deprived and forbidden therefrom.

order.why: Consider learning that does not ensure recognition.
shortened: How many were the divines and the learned and the jurisprudents who longed for the presence of God, yet after His manifestation remained deprived thereof, while thou didst drink from the choice wine of reunion and didst attain unto the kingdom of meeting.

order.why: Retain the contrast between expectation and refusal.
Hear the rebuke addressed to heedlessness.
shortened: Say: You have been created to attain the presence of God - what is wrong with you that We see you among the heedless?

order.why: Keep the appeal to open one’s hearing.
Retain the paired blessing and warning.
shortened: Verily He hath appeared with the truth and hath opened the gate of reunion before all who are in earth and heaven. Blessed is he who hath attained the presence, and woe unto every heedless one who hath turned away by following those who have disbelieved in the Beginning and the Return.

order.why: Hear the severe warning about losing the opportunity.
shortened: Know with certainty that ye shall never again hear the melodies of God, never draw nigh unto a manifest meeting with Him, never witness the beauty of God among you, and never shall the words of God, the Mighty, the Glorious, the Gracious, be cast upon you.

order.why: Distinguish visiting names from recognizing their source.
shortened: By God! His visitation is regarded by God as better than those who have visited and do visit in these days the shrines bearing Our names and are counted among the visitors - for they visit mere names while remaining veiled from their Creator and Originator, and are among the heedless ones.

order.why: Keep the sorrow of being prevented from entering.
shortened: Yet when they drew near, they were prevented from entering the precincts of Thy mighty oneness and from attaining presence before Thy majestic throne.

order.why: Remember those who never reached the desired shelter.
shortened: How many souls rushed forth into the deadly wilderness and were consumed by the heat of deprivation, never tasting a drop of the wine of reunion from the hand of the Cup-bearer of attainment, while you, through the favor of the Most Glorious Beloved, have entered beneath the sheltering shade of the Tree of the Uttermost End. This is a bounty that hath ever been the ultimate desire of the denizens of the Supreme Concourse.

order.why: Let the grief of prevented seekers be heard.
Name hostility as an obstacle to a mutually desired meeting.
shortened: Thou didst desire reunion; the Wronged One too desireth it, but the smoke of heedless hearts hath become an obstacle, and the hatred of souls hath appeared as an impenetrable barrier.

order.why: Offer the assurance that sincere desire is recognized.
Keep the reward promised to one who desired to come.
shortened: He verily ordaineth for whomsoever hath desired to attain His presence and to stand before His gate the reward thereof.

order.why: Read desire itself as attainment in the source’s terms.
shortened: By My life! He who desires My presence is among those who have attained the presence of My countenance, heard My call, and attained the Kawthar of My meeting and the choice wine of My reunion.

order.why: Include those turned toward a forbidden quarter.
shortened: We make mention of everyone who desireth to turn towards this forbidden quarter, and We ordain for whomsoever We please the reward of attaining His presence.

order.why: Keep the bestowal of that reward within divine will.
shortened: God, exalted be His glory, ordains the reward of attaining His presence for whomsoever He wishes.

order.why: Include every woman and man who turns toward God.
shortened: A mention from Our presence to her who has turned to the Countenance and desired to draw near to the Most Great Sea when most men turned away from it, that the breezes of revelation might attract her to a station beyond which all allusions are cut off.
We make mention of every handmaiden who hath turned to God and every servant who hath faced his Lord, the Cleaver of the Dawn.

order.why: Pray for loved ones unable to stand before the face.
Ask the reward of those who heard and visited.
shortened: We beseech God to ordain for him the reward of those who attained the presence of the Countenance and were blessed to hearken to the call of their Lord, the All-Protecting over what was and what shall be, and the reward of those who circumambulated the Throne and drank the Kawthar of immortality from the hands of bounty and stood before the Gate that was opened unto all who are on earth and in heaven.

order.why: Retain the personal petition for that recompense.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy might and dominion and by the mysteries of Thy Manifestation that Thou write down for me, with Thy Most Exalted Pen, the recompense of attaining Thy presence and standing before Thy face.

order.why: Keep the specific promise of renewed covenant and nearness.
Let a letter testify to relationship.
shortened: The presence of your letter testifies that you are with Someone, and under the shadow of Someone - but what Someone! The King of all beings and the Creator of earth and heaven.

order.why: Remember the benefit of being mentioned.
Hear remembrance offered from prison.
shortened: O Ismail! The All-Glorious hath turned toward thee from this Prison and mentioned thee in such wise as to set ablaze the hearts of them that are near unto God.

order.why: Keep the assurance of companionship through difficulty.
Give thanks for turning without being prevented by veils.
shortened: This is Thy servant who hath been illumined by the lamp of Thy oneness and hath turned toward the seat of the throne of Thy grandeur, and hath found the breezes of Thy name, the All-Glorious, from the right hand of certitude from this direction wherein Thy sovereignty hath been established over all who are in the heavens and on earth, and Thy countenance hath shone forth unto Thy creatures who were not prevented by the veils of glory from turning unto Thy majesty nor by the veils of error from beholding Thy beauty.

order.why: Read one’s life through sustained guidance and an opened gate.
shortened: Thou art He Who created me and sustained me until Thou didst honor me with Thy days wherein the Sun of Thy loving-kindness dawned from the horizon of Thy Will and was established upon the throne of Thy mercy, and Thou didst open the gate of attainment unto Thy presence before the face of all who dwell in Thy earth and Thy heaven, and didst call all unto Thyself, and didst attract all through Thy signs.

order.why: Pray from need for life, existence and forgiveness.
shortened: O Lord! This is one dead who desireth the breaths of Thy revelation and what would give him life through the eternity of Thy might and sovereignty; and this is one non-existent who seeketh existence from the heaven of Thy bounty and the sea of Thy generosity and the sun of Thy grace; and this is one poor whom Thou seest clinging to the hem of Thy riches and holding fast to the cord of Thy bestowals; and a sinner who desireth the ocean of Thy forgiveness; and one deaf who desireth to hear Thy most sweet call which hath been raised from the direction of Thy prison.

order.why: Keep the extreme language of longing attributed to its prayer.
shortened: I would rather Thou shouldst torment me with a torment than which there can be none greater in Thy knowledge, and ordain for me the sweetness of meeting Thee.

order.why: Hear the demanding response imagined before the spoken word.
shortened: O Ali! The Dayspring of the Cause addresseth thee in most wondrous utterance. By God! Wert thou to be present before the Throne and hear it from the Tongue of grandeur and power, thou wouldst sacrifice thy body, then thy spirit, then thy very self, for love of God, the Sovereign Lord, the All-Compelling, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Remember the price given for even one mention.
Keep yearning for the call within its revealed imagery.
Acknowledge mystery surrounding what is sought.
shortened: We beseech God, exalted be He, to show you the Sun that shineth from its depths - verily it is the mystery, and the mystery of the mystery, and the mystery enshrouded in mystery.

order.why: Retain the hidden names and elemental imagery of its prayer.
Keep the value assigned to what was revealed.
Connect prophetic education with preparation for death.
shortened: The purpose underlying Their revelation hath been to educate all men, that they may, at the hour of death, ascend, in the utmost purity and sanctity and with absolute detachment, to the throne of the Most High.

order.why: Hear a departed servant described as attaining.
shortened: He hath abandoned this mortal life and hath flown to the kingdom of immortality, yearning for the favour of meeting Thee.
He hath, verily, attained the meeting of his Lord at the seat of Truth in the presence of the potent King.

order.why: Read the plea for reception and the garden of shelter.
Pray for meeting after ascension.
shortened: Permit him to meet Thee after his ascension to the realms above and to behold Thy beauty in Thy most luminous, most brilliant Horizon.

order.why: Keep the departed soul’s desire for nearness.
shortened: He desired to ascend to the canopy of union with and meeting with Thee, and to abide in the seats of nearness to and proximity with Thee.

order.why: Receive the invitation when the Kingdom’s doors open.
Strive toward meeting at ascension.
shortened: Strive that ye may attain unto this most great bounty, that at the time of ascension ye may meet the luminous countenance of the Desired One.

order.why: Seek protection and sustenance amid hostility.
shortened: And shield me from the arrows of the people of doubts aimed at me from all directions, that I may find rest at the gate of Thy oneness in Thy most glorious kingdom and receive sustenance from the banquets of meeting.

order.why: Remember a life of sustained thirst and hope.
shortened: Verily Thy servant who has turned toward Thee, who has sought the gate of Thy forgiveness, has ever lived thirsting for the cup of meeting Thee, yearning to gaze upon Thy beauty, stirred by Thy sweet fragrances, longing to hear Thy voice, hoping to attain Thy threshold.

order.why: Keep the prisoner’s gracious words before death.
Read attainment, return and later ascension together.
shortened: Blessed is he who hath ascended unto God along this path. Verily he hath attained the presence of God and drunk the choice wine of reunion, and returned by God's command, the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted, until he ascended unto Him.

order.why: Ask for nearness and companionship among the loved ones.
shortened: Grant him nearness to Thee, O Most Bountiful! Bestow upon him the gift of meeting Thee, O Most Kind! Make him the intimate of Thy gracious countenance and the companion of Thy loved ones in the Paradise of Delight.

order.why: Recall yearning toward forgiveness and favor.
shortened: Thus he yearned to be present at Your holy threshold and hastened to the source of favors, the fountain of forgiveness, and the place of grace and benevolence.

order.why: Hear the grief expressed in longing for ascension.
shortened: I swear by the Ancient Beauty, may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones, that solace is impossible except through ascension to the Abha Kingdom and entering the presence of the Most Great Mercy.

order.why: Allow a station’s value to remain not yet evident.
Retain the assurance of meeting in all worlds.
Pray for both recipients across divine worlds.
shortened: We beseech Him, exalted be He, to draw you both near unto Him in every world among His worlds, to grant you the bounty of attaining His presence in His dominion and kingdom, and to send down upon you from the heaven of His generosity the table of His knowledge and the grace of His munificence.

order.why: Receive the promise of continued companionship.
Ask to be gathered together in immortality.
shortened: We beseech God to gather us together in the gardens of immortality near unto the twin glorious bows, that haply thou mayest witness the secrets of God's decree within this crimson and effulgent countenance, that the blessing of God upon thee and upon all who are on earth may be made complete.

order.why: Join future companionship with grace in this world.
shortened: In the Most Glorious Kingdom make them intimate companions in the gathering of manifestation, and bring them into Thy private chamber, and in this world too bestow upon them every grace worthy and free.

order.why: Pray through tears for joy in both worlds.
shortened: O Lord! Have mercy upon these flowing tears and these agitated hearts. Ordain for us the joy of meeting in the most exalted Paradise, and pass round to us the cup of bounty in this world and the next.

order.why: Turn from remoteness toward a place of refuge.
Read the longing for pilgrimage to the holy ground.
shortened: In this momentous day and wondrous time, when the fragrances of the garden of Ridvan and the breezes of the paradise of certitude have perfumed the nostrils of the spiritually-minded, and the divine fragrance hath made both East and West redolent with musk - when the sweet scent of the hallowed sanctuary hath bestowed life upon the nostrils of the yearning ones, and the fragrance of the blessed dust hath conferred ecstasy upon the minds of the spiritually-minded - no greater bounty could there be than attaining the presence of that holy ground and anointing one's eyes with the dust of that Most Great Threshold.

order.why: Connect visitation with humility and gratitude.
shortened: You circumambulated the Sacred Shrine in utmost humility and submissiveness, and visited the Sacred Precinct in complete devotion and supplication.

This circumambulation in the sacred court of Him Who is the Hidden Bestower of Favors is accepted and beloved, and gratitude for this acceptance is among the decisive obligations for those who are firmly grounded.

order.why: Keep the reported enumeration of received blessings.
shortened: First, that you reached the Holy Shrine with pure intention in such a day and such a century - this is the ultimate bounty. Second, that you were blessed to visit the Sacred Threshold. Third, that you attained the presence of the Most Exalted One.

order.why: Attend to loss, memory and the Shrine’s calm influence.
Keep the particular promise concerning dreams.
Receive a gathering as a place of thanksgiving.
Read the City of God through dwelling together.
Pray for joy shared in an eternal celebration.
Hope for a friend’s arrival.
Seek a meeting in health and well-being.
shortened: Furthermore, in all conditions I beseech and hope that that beloved and those with him will proceed to the ultimate destination in perfect health and well-being, so that we may attain to meeting, which is the greatest of God's bounties, glorified be His majesty, and under the shade of His blessed Tree offer thanks and praise.

order.why: Give thanks for hearing and beholding.
Keep the thanksgiving of one honored to be present.
shortened: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having honored me with Thy presence and given me to drink of the Kawthar of Thy reunion, and caused me to be seated in the sacred precincts at the manifestation of Thy power and sovereignty.

order.why: Respond to remembrance with praise.
shortened: When thou dost inhale the fragrance of My mention and hear My call, say:
Glory be unto Thee, O my God! All praise be unto Thee for having remembered me from Thy most exalted horizon and for having sent down unto me that which drew unto it the Concourse on High.

order.why: Attend to permission and the limits of recounting an encounter.
Preserve the intermediary’s account of presenting a letter.
Carry an encounter outward in travel and remembrance.
Visit on behalf of another while remembering service.
shortened: Set thy face toward the Ultimate Goal and the Most Exalted Summit, that thou mayest visit on behalf of him whom God hath extolled in His Book, and given to drink of the Kawthar of His presence and the Salsabil of His reunion, and caused to speak forth His remembrance and praise, and established to serve His Cause.

order.why: Pray for aid to one who arose to serve.
Read a separation for service as a means of enduring union.
Let teaching become preferable to another long pilgrimage.
shortened: Although, in accordance with your request, permission was granted for you to direct yourself once again to the Prison, yet if you were to transform this traversing of a long distance into teaching the divine Word, it would be more excellent and more beloved, for praise be to God, you have attained His presence and drunk from the wine of reunion.

order.why: Keep tongue, eye, ear and heart attentive afterward.
shortened: O My community and My leaf! The Wronged One calleth thee from the precincts of the Prison and inviteth thee to the supreme horizon, that perchance thy tongue may not cease from mention, nor thine eye from beholding, nor thine ear from hearkening, nor thy heart from turning toward Him.

order.why: Hear the call with heart and soul.
shortened: Hearken unto the call of Him Who is the Manifestation of the Cause, the Lord of Destiny, and with heart and soul turn toward the Most Great Scene, that thou mayest behold the Eternal Countenance from the horizon of the everlasting heaven and drink, after the passing away of all things, from the Kawthar of reunion with the Lord of Names.

order.why: Turn toward reunion’s ocean.
shortened: Turn thou unto the ocean of reunion that thou mayest attain unto the presence of God, the Mighty, the Most Praised.

order.why: Receive counsel that draws one nearer.
shortened: He verily commands you to that which will draw you nigh unto a station wherein naught is seen save the radiance of My shining and luminous countenance.

order.why: Let effort seek what quickens hearts.
Keep nourishment through the water of presence.
Close the linked readings with a choice about one’s path.
shortened: Ponder, then, upon thy affair, and choose for thyself what thou desirest. But if thou wouldst hearken unto Me, choose that which will draw thee nigh unto the meeting with thy Beloved and will unite thee with thy Lord and thy Goal.

order.why: Keep the separately supplied testimony with its own attribution.
Consider Plotinus’s supplied account of reunion without equating traditions.
Retain the provisional passage and its internal omission.
Close with life’s experiences leading toward knowledge, love and worship.

questions: What does the contrast between physical distance and spiritual nearness reveal about the kind of presence described here?
How do these readings relate the transcendence of God to the possibility of recognition and meeting through the Manifestations?
What do remembered journeys, visits, voices, and letters add to the more inward language of love and remembrance?
How do the passages address longing that cannot be fulfilled outwardly, and how might their assurances be understood alongside their warnings about missed recognition?
What connections and distinctions emerge when John’s exchange with Philip and Qur’an 18:110 are read beside the compilation?
How might a cherished encounter change the way a person serves, makes choices, or accompanies others through separation and loss?

references.label: 1 · John 14:8–11 · Philip asks to see the Father
references.note: Philip’s request receives an answer that connects seeing Jesus with seeing the Father, and points to words and works. Read this conversation beside the compilation’s account of meeting through the Manifestations, attending carefully to the Gospel’s own language about the Father and Son rather than treating the theological accounts as interchangeable.

references.label: 2 · Qur’an 18:110 · Meeting and righteous action
references.note: The verse joins the messenger’s mortal humanity and received revelation with divine oneness, then connects hope of meeting the Lord with righteous work and undivided worship. Compare its practical demand with this compilation’s relationship between recognition, nearness, and the life that follows an encounter.

subjects.displayTitle: Divine unity: beyond number, toward a life of oneness
subjects.introduction: To say that God is one sounds like the simplest confession a believer can make, yet Bahá’u’lláh warns that it is possible to repeat it morning and evening and still live as an idolater. Unity is not a matter of counting; it is not the joining of two things into one, nor the notion that creature and Creator share a nature. It is to know the One as sanctified above number, likeness and thought, and then to see every created thing sustained by Him, as mirrors catch a sun that never leaves its own heaven. The Báb presses the paradox further: whoever claims to have comprehended that Essence has only described himself. The brief Qur’ánic surah that denies God any equal [1] and the scribe who heard Jesus bind the one Lord to the love of neighbour [2] mark two edges of the same mystery. From here one can follow how the divine oneness is distinguished in its degrees, how the Manifestations are one and yet many, and what station they hold, until the confession is written in a life of concord and service.
subjects.arc: Begin with the limits of praise and the demands of lived unity; distinguish Essence, signs and Manifestations; explore the language of negation, names and revelation; follow prayer into recognition and close with service and concord.

order.why: Distinguish true unity from adding two beings together.
shortened: This is the essence of unity - that ye should behold the True One alone as all-prevailing over all things and manifest in the mirrors of all created things. Know ye all things to be sustained by Him and drawing their essence from Him. This is the meaning of unity and the purpose thereof.
Unity is to know the One as One and to consider Him sanctified above numbers, not to regard two as one.

order.why: Open with the difficulty of praising beyond one’s capacity.
Ask that every limb testify to unity.
shortened: Thus do We announce unto you from the signs of the unity of God and from that which you were bidden so that you may declare the Oneness of God, your Creator, with your inner and outer tongues in such wise that His signs appear in all your limbs and you may be counted among them who acknowledge His Unity.

order.why: Connect oneness with love, service and peace.
State the absence of likeness or comparison.
shortened: And what is meant by true unity is that God hath no likeness or similitude. All bear witness that He was and is sanctified above peers and likenesses, and exalted above that which the hearts of servants have comprehended.

order.why: Keep Creator and creature distinct.
shortened: He, in truth, hath, throughout eternity, been one in His Essence, one in His attributes, one in His works. Any and every comparison is applicable only to His creatures, and all conceptions of association are conceptions that belong solely to those that serve Him. Immeasurably exalted is His Essence above the descriptions of His creatures.

Shall, then, the thing that was born by virtue of the word which His Pen hath revealed, and which the finger of His Will hath directed, be regarded as partner with Him, or an embodiment of His Self? Far be it from His glory that human pen or tongue should hint at His mystery, or that human heart conceive His Essence.

order.why: Reject identifying one’s own person with God.
shortened: That which the aforesaid persons have mentioned concerning the stations of Divine Unity will conduce in no small measure to idleness and vain imaginings. These mortal men have evidently set aside the differences of station and have come to regard themselves as God, while God is immeasurably exalted above all things.

order.why: Acknowledge that created eyes cannot behold the divine Essence.
Pray against imagining descent or ascent in the divine reality.
Explain why division belongs to contingent things.
shortened: Question: What is the meaning of the Trinity and of its three Persons?

Answer: The reality of the Divinity is sanctified and exalted beyond the comprehension of all created things, can in no wise be imagined by mortal mind and understanding, and transcends all human conception. That reality admits of no division, for division and multiplicity are among the characteristics of created and hence contingent things, and not accidents impinging upon the Necessary Being.

order.why: Consider the unity of Essence and attributes.
Explains divine attributes as expressions of one indivisible perfection.
Distinguish conceptual existence from simple reality.
shortened: If conceptual existence - which is encompassed and falls under conception and perception - in terms of its reality abstracted from relations and connections is an identity sanctified from multiplicities in the oneness of the Essence, what then of the Simple Universal Reality which encompasses realities and perceptions and is sanctified above imaginations and indications, nay, above every description and attribute, being the essence of Oneness and the simplicity of Unity, for it is a Divine Reality abstracted from every attribute, sign, and indication. Could multiplicity, plurality, or distinction be conceived therein from the viewpoint of the perfections of the Essence, its relationship to attributes, and its all-comprehensiveness of divine and lordly names which necessitate the existence of contingent beings? God forbid!

order.why: Continue the philosophical account of predication.
shortened: Those pre-eminent Sufis who founded the doctrine of the "unity of existence" never intended by this term the universally predicated existence which is conceived by the mind. For such an existence is but an accident among others occurring in association with the realities of things. That is to say, these realities are the substance, whereas that existence which is conceived by the mind, the universally predicated existence, is but an accident associated with them.

order.why: Test the limits of unity claimed through one’s own essence.
Hear the Bab’s account of the unknowable Essence.
shortened: And know thou that the Ancient Being's outer reality is His very inner reality, and His essence is His very being. He hath ever been, and no thing had existence, and now too He is as He was in eternity, and no thing hath existence at His level. Whatsoever can be termed a thing, apart from the Essence of God, is His creation. His Essence is known to none, for knowledge requireth existence and association, and all else hath no existence at His level, much less requiring association. None hath known God save His holy Essence, and none hath unified God save His holy Essence.

order.why: Ask what a description can actually comprehend.
Let the failure of description become prayer.
Challenge confidence in one’s understanding of unity.
Keep the overwhelming character of the claimed station.
Praise beyond the limits of praise.
shortened: Unique glorification, sanctified above limitation and the knowledge of created things, befitteth the court of might of that Eternal One, Who hath been and shall forever be ensconced within His own most holy and exalted sanctuary, and Who, from time immemorial unto time everlasting, shall remain upon the seat and throne of His independence and grandeur.

order.why: Read the confession of incomparability.
shortened: Praise be to God, Who, by the exaltation of His Essence, hath ascended to a height before which all things fall away; and Who, by the grandeur of His Being, hath been enthroned upon the Seat of Oneness, before whose Countenance all bow the head -- He is the solitary God, the Eternal, the One, the Living, the Self-Subsisting, the Single, the Unrivalled; Who hath taken unto Himself neither consort nor son, nor hath He any partner in might, nor protector out of abasement.

order.why: Receive the word of unity as mercy and transcendence.
Join turning toward God with sanctifying the Essence.
Introduce the mirror analogy without imagining the Sun descends.
shortened: Although it transcends our realization, its lights, bestowals, traces and virtues have become manifest in the realities of the Prophets, even as the sun becomes resplendent in various mirrors. These holy realities are as reflectors, and the reality of Divinity is as the sun, which, although it is reflected from the mirrors, and its virtues and perfections become resplendent therein, does not stoop from its own station of majesty and glory and seek abode in the mirrors; it remains in its heaven of sanctity.

This is the unity of God; this is oneness -- unity of Divinity, holy above ascent or descent, embodiment, comprehension or idealization -- divine unity. The Prophets are its mirrors; its lights are revealed through Them; its virtues become resplendent in Them, but the Sun of Reality never descends from its own highest point and station.

order.why: Read the two stations of the Manifestations together.
shortened: It hath ever been evident that all these divergences of utterance are attributable to differences of station. Thus, viewed from the standpoint of their oneness and sublime detachment, the attributes of Godhead, Divinity, Supreme Singleness, and Inmost Essence, have been and are applicable to those Essences of being, inasmuch as they all abide on the throne of divine Revelation, and are established upon the seat of divine Concealment.

order.why: Follow the one sun through repeated risings.
shortened: I testify, O Thou Who art the Lord of the whole creation, and the Desire of whosoever hath sought Thee, that, amidst Thy creatures, They resemble the sun which no matter how often it riseth and setteth is still the one and the same sun. Whoso maketh any distinction between any of Them hath truly failed to attain the ultimate purpose, and to reach the highest goal, and hath been deprived of the mysteries of unity and of the lights of sanctity and oneness.

order.why: Consider the refusal to distinguish the Manifestations.
shortened: Beware, O believers in the Unity of God, lest ye be tempted to make any distinction between any of the Manifestations of His Cause, or to discriminate against the signs that have accompanied and proclaimed their Revelation. This indeed is the true meaning of Divine Unity, if ye be of them that apprehend and believe this truth.

order.why: Keep the reported explanation of one soul and servitude.
Hold prophetic authority beside servitude.
shortened: The Holy Ones -- may the blessings of God be upon them -- were created through the potency of His Word, and after Him they were the most learned and the most distinguished among the people and abide in the utmost station of servitude. The divine Essence, sanctified from every comparison and likeness, is established in the Prophet, and God's inmost Reality, exalted above any peer or partner, is manifest in Him. This is the station of true unity and of veritable singleness.

order.why: Read the Messengers as dawning-places of oneness.
Distinguish the one Sun through essence, attributes and deeds.
Compare changing candlesticks and one light.
Recognize differing responses to the same dawning.
Explore the unity of names at revelation.
Read the Word appearing in different forms.
Enter the Bab’s distinction between Essence, Will and names.
shortened: All the most excellent Names belong to the Will, while the depth of His Essence is sanctified above any Name or praise, the purity (kafur ) of His indivisible unity (sadhij) is exalted above any glory or loftiness, and the substance of His transcendence is glorified above any height or sublimity. He is the First, yet not defined by it, and He is the Last, but not described by it. He is the Seen, and not praised by it, and He is Hidden, and not recognized by it.

order.why: Follow created pairs without dividing their source.
shortened: Say: God hath created no letter but He hath created thereby a male or female. Say: God createth no male but He createth for it of itself a female. Say: God createth no female but He createth of itself a male by God's living command. Say: God sendeth down no single thing but He createth of itself a pair unto God, the Lord of the worlds, and God createth no pair but He createth of itself a single thing unto God, the Lord of the worlds. Thus doth God ordain the measures of all things in the Book.

order.why: Keep the different temporal levels of Essence and Will.
Consider the eternal relation of creation to its cause.
Pray through knowledge, guidance and continuing creation.
shortened: Through Thee have I known Thee - there is no God but Thee. Through Thee have I found Thee - there is no God but Thee. Through Thee have I been guided to Thee - there is no God but Thee. Through Thee have I drawn near unto Thee alone - there is no God but Thee. Through Thee have I ascended to what lieth with Thee alone - there is no God but Thee. Through Thee have I become independent of all save Thee alone - there is no God but Thee.

I bear witness, O my God, that Thou hast ever been and wilt ever be. At no time can there be separated from Thee what befitteth Thy creation or beseemeth Thy handiwork. Thy dominion in Thy kingdom and the manifestations of Thy creation in Thy dominion have ever existed and will ever endure. Were I to say at any time that Thou art Thou and hadst no creation, I would negate my knowledge of Thy power and certainty of Thy Lordship.

order.why: Consider mercy as ever manifest in creation.
Read Will and Purpose within their stated distinctions.
Retain the symbolic account of identity and geometry.
shortened: From it unto it did it shine forth, and through it did it stammer, and unto it through it did it submit, and through it was duality completed and identity created, and the Will was mentioned through the mention of primordial, original geometry. Thus it is neither of primordial eternity nor of ultimate perpetuity, but rather it shineth forth from the Sun of Oneness, gleaming from the glory of the Impenetrable, enduring through the endurance of the Supreme Identity.

order.why: Keep the reported philosophical triads attributed.
Read the reported comparative vocabulary without equating its traditions.
shortened: We, of the Orient, distinguish between the wholly transcendent Primal Deity, in the Christian sense God the Father, and the Logos (Gospel of St. John, chapt. 1, verses 1 and 2), in the Christian sense God the Son, also called Demiurge (in the sense of the Greek philosophers), also called the Primal Will by His Holiness the Bab and designated by the Sufis (religious brotherhood) by the name of tawhid = oneness.

order.why: Distinguish divine signs from God and from moral equivalence.
shortened: Say: O people! What relationship can there be between the Imagined and the Self-Subsisting, and what similarity between creation and the Creator, when they were created by the stroke of His Pen, and this effect itself is sanctified, holy and exempt from all else? And passing beyond this station, consider in the station of signs that the sun is one of the divine signs. Can one consider it in the same station as darkness? Nay, by His very Self, the Truth! None would speak thus save he whose heart is straitened and whose vision is dimmed.
Unity is to behold the revelation of Truth in all signs, not to consider creation as Truth.

order.why: Follow the passage from unity of existence to divine appearance.
shortened: Yet others, assisted by the grace of the everlasting Friend, consume these veils with the fire of His love and step into the meads of ancient glory. That is, forsaking the wilderness of the "unity of existence", they attain unto the ultimate abode of the "true appearance of the Divine Unity". So clearly will they witness in this stage God's all-encompassing mercy that in every created thing, both in the world and in the souls of men, they will behold Him Who hath been interpreted as the Holy Outpouring.

order.why: Read the valley of oneness as a stage of journey.
shortened: 35 After passing through the Valley of Knowledge, which is the last station of limitation, the wayfarer cometh to the FIRST STATION OF UNITY and drinketh from the cup of oneness, and gazeth upon the manifestations of singleness. In this station he pierceth the veils of plurality, fleeth the realms of the flesh, and ascendeth unto the heaven of unity. With the ear of God he heareth; with the eye of God he beholdeth the mysteries of divine creation.

order.why: Enter the garden beyond entry and exit.
Keep the ocean beyond paired opposites.
Return to the explanation that unity is not two becoming one.
shortened: In one of the Persian tablets He says, exalted be His glory and sublime be His praise: The purpose of Divine Unity is not to consider two as one, rather its purpose is to consider the One as sanctified above all, for He is not associated with His creation nor is He known through any other than Himself. And one should observe the lights of His manifestations in all things, that is, to see all things sustained by Him and dependent upon Him. This is the station wherein He says "God was, and there was nothing else besides Him." He has ever been, in the heights of inaccessibility and in the summit of exaltation, sanctified above all things and ever shall be.

order.why: Locate the explanation in named revealed works.
shortened: The meaning of unity has been explained by the Ancient Beauty - may my spirit and being be sacrificed for His steadfast loved ones - in the Tablet to Salman and in the Book of Certitude and other divine Tablets with clearest exposition.

order.why: Distinguish unity of essence, attributes, names and actions.
shortened: It is clear and evident that, in this Dispensation wherein the banner of utterance hath been raised aloft and the candle of discernment hath been lit, there is no Lord but the Exalted One. He it is Who is one in His essence and one in His attributes, single in the kingdom of names and peerless in the realm of actions.

order.why: Read outward and inward horizons together.
shortened: O you who gaze upon the Most Luminous Beauty and who hold fast to the Most Pure Hem and who cling to the Sure Handle with the clinging of one who supplicates, who is detached, who implores the Most Great Sublime One - know that the Most Great Luminary and the Most Ancient Light, when it rises and shines forth from the East of the world upon all peoples, has two rising places, two dawning places, two horizons and two setting places: an outward, material, concrete horizon in the external world, and an inward, heart-centered, spiritual, knowledge-based, consciously-experienced horizon in the mind.

order.why: Keep light and darkness distinct within the image of seas.
shortened: O thou who art attracted by the fragrances of God! Verily the Lord Who manifested Himself upon the Mount with the power of Revelation has caused two seas to flow - the sea of darkness and the sea of light. They meet together - one sweet, palatable, cool and refreshing to drink, the other salty and bitter, nay putrid and mirage-like. And He has placed between them a barrier and boundary that they may not mix or mingle.

order.why: Consider the assertion that reality is one.
shortened: Consider with the eye of reality. The aim of life is reality, and reality is one. Reality does not accept multiplicity.
This is the essence of the teachings, and an established, self-evident fact.

order.why: Read interdependence without severing natural connections.
Listen to the created world’s language of praise.
Let all things give their testimony.
Hear the concise witness of created things.
Join oneness with greatness and power.
Consider what would remain without the divine signs.
shortened: By Thy glory, O my God, whenever I have sought other than Thee, I found it naught, and whenever I desired other than Thee, I witnessed it not. And whenever I descend from the most exalted heights to the lowest depths of earth, I find nothing except signs of Thy oneness, tokens of Thy singleness, intimations of Thy lordship, and evidences of Thy self-subsistence, to such extent that were Thou to remove Thy signs from existence, nothing would remain in Thy kingdom and no letter would be witnessed in Thy realm.

order.why: Let a speck of dust testify without comprehending the Essence.
Keep the sign in all things within the letter’s interpretive setting.
shortened: However, when I heard that the binding command had been issued from His Excellency--may God perpetuate his glory--to your honor to interpret what I had composed in Arabic regarding the specific Muhammadan Prophethood--may God's blessings be upon it--I began this address so that you might spread these pages before His Excellency--may God perpetuate his favor--and explain to him in the best possible manner at the station of exposition, in accordance with His exalted Word: "In all things there is a sign pointing to the fact that He is One."

order.why: Hear the atoms join the Revealer’s testimony.
Compare the signs with human recognition.
shortened: Say: O people! By God the Truth! The signs of God shine forth amidst the signs of men as the sun shineth forth between the heavens and the earth. Beware lest ye compare them with aught else.

order.why: Consider the comprehensive Point and its meanings.
shortened: Praise be to God Who created and brought forth a comprehensive, perfect, all-encompassing Point, possessing and containing all universal meanings in the world of existence, wherein all realities, effects and ordinances are integrated and included through simplicity and unity, calling to oneness in all affairs in the realm of being.

order.why: Enter the Bab’s extended account of number, negation and affirmation.
shortened: Say: Your God is but one God. There is no God but He, the Sovereign, the Self-Subsisting. Say: The number one, then one, God created from it. Will you not then attribute numbers to God? For all numbers are His creation, and all are devoutly obedient to Him.

For when thou sayest "except the sun of heaven" there existeth no sun to oppose it; likewise when thou sayest "there is no god but God" there existeth no god besides God, and there is none before Him to oppose Him. And verily what thou seest of the conditions of negation are but weaker than this and more feeble than that.

order.why: Follow the movement from no to except.
Keep the two sides of the confession in their revealed imagery.
Read the negation of negation as a religious foundation.
shortened: Say not "ah" - nay, rather say "There is no God but God." Verily, ye must negate negation and then affirm affirmation. This is the foundation of religion, would ye but reflect.

order.why: Receive that difficult language as supplication.
Read the confession in the Bab’s account of religion’s foundations.
Distinguish the four pillars in their historical vocabulary.
shortened: And verily religion is established upon four pillars: the unity of God [al-tawhid], the reality of prophethood [al-nubuwwa], the succession of authority [al-walaya], and the community of followers [al-shi'a]: four gates, the first of which cannot be sound without the last. All of these are the Face of God which perisheth not, and it is the love of the Family of God, which is none other than the love of God Himself, Who is the Hidden Treasure.

order.why: Keep the sequence of symbolic stations intact.
Explore the letters vav and ha.
Continue the meanings assigned to the letter ha.
Read the five stations of vav in their own setting.
Bring body, soul, intellect and heart into the invocations.
shortened: Then, when thou returnest and completeth the journey of descent and desirest to ascend unto God, the Loving Lord, make the first the last: let the portion of thy body be "Glory be to Thee, O God!"; of thy soul, "Praise be to God!"; of thy intellect, "There is no God but God!"; and of thy heart, "God is the Greatest!" Look not upon these manifestations with the gaze of difference, for such is not the path of the people of reality and the retreat of return.

order.why: Explore the pronoun and the First, Last, Hidden and Manifest.
Return to the paired descriptions of first and last.
Distinguish inward and outward aspects of letters.
shortened: Know thou furthermore that each letter of these sacred words hath two aspects - one turning toward the inner meaning and one toward the outer.

order.why: Consider multiplicity as expressing unity.
Keep the reported numerical analogy and its ranking attributed.
shortened: Expressed mathematically, God is the great One. - Religion is the zero, or the zeroes, which only gain significance and value through the One connected with them! Take the number 100 or 1,000 or 100,000 or more, what are the zeroes without the One which precedes them?
The High Religions are several zeroes preceded by the great One, the Godhead. The lower religions have only one or two zeroes after the great One.

order.why: Turn from numbers to dependence upon the True One.
Read the Tablet of All Food beside its scriptural language.
Retain the Bab’s criticism of Trinitarian belief as a particular theological claim.
shortened: And verily, most men, in the plane of reality, behold not the Real; for were they upon the pure Straight Path wherein no trace of association is mentioned, it would be otherwise. For the speaker hath not beheld God; hence his deed -- and even his own self -- worketh not for God in utter purity, nor doth he set in motion the intention of drawing nigh unto Him. This is the creed of the Christians -- exalted is God above what they allege -- inasmuch as they have said: "God is the third of three."

order.why: Read the Bab’s extended account of recognition and return.
shortened: Since the affirmation of affirmation is contingent upon affirming the Manifestation of Affirmation, it is for this reason that the mention of prophethood has become conjoined with the mention of divine unity. For whosoever fails to acknowledge the second will remain veiled from the first.

Therefore in every Dispensation, the Exponents of God have hastened to exalt and elevate His Throne, and have striven to establish and glorify the Seat of His transcendent Oneness, so that through this means the Sun of the Divine Unity might shine upon the mirrors of all created things, making them ready to receive the Word of Unity in the next Resurrection.

order.why: Follow the Joseph imagery through transcendence and servitude.
shortened: God hath created Joseph and his brethren from the Blessed Tree of Unity, and people know not from their expressions the mystery of what was inscribed with God, the Truth, in the Mother Book, around the Fire.
