Say: God is my Lord and your Lord in truth. He hath appointed me as a witness to this Greatest Word in truth. I am but a man like unto you. God bestoweth His favor upon me as He willeth, with what He willeth.

order.why: Consider how negating names still reflects the seeker’s capacity.
Keep names from being confused with the Essence.
Read the demand for undivided worship.
Connect divine origin and return with worship.
Keep fasting, testimony and the paths of creation together.
Retain the attributed claim concerning unseen knowledge.
Read the purification of names toward the Most Great Name.
Keep the stated station of a particular person beyond names.
shortened: Dost thou reckon him as one among the servants? Nay, by the Lord of all existence! Through him have all tribes been seized with earthquakes, the pillars of tyranny have trembled, and the countenance of victory hath shone forth from the horizon of power. Can names attain unto him? Nay, by their Lord! He hath ascended unto a station beyond all mention.

order.why: Let the friends revolve around the divine Will.
shortened: The Supreme Pen hath, in the prison of 'Akka, turned towards the loved ones in the land of Kha, that is, those souls who have been adorned with the new raiment, who are turned towards the horizon of oneness, and who revolve, through their essential, original motion, around the Will of God.

order.why: Read the names in preparation for Him Whom God shall make manifest.
Turn glorification toward the hoped-for day of recognition.
Offer testimony while acknowledging the limits of knowledge.
shortened: I bear witness that there is no God but Thee, as Thou hast testified to Thine own Self, without any of Thy creation comprehending its knowledge. And I bear witness to Muhammad and his successors - Thy blessings be upon them - according to what Thou hast ordained for them in the knowledge of the unseen with Thee.

order.why: Retain the confession in its visitation setting.
shortened: I bear witness before God and what is in His knowledge that there is no God but Him, alone with no partner. His is the Kingdom and Command, there is no God but Him, the Great, the Exalted.

order.why: Hear the testimony of God, angels and those with knowledge.
Read life and death through the divine command.
Join confession with the Book’s authority.
Let repeated confession extend beyond counting.
Hear power and inaccessibility together.
shortened: Thou hast ever been triumphant over all created things, manifest unto all contingent beings, powerful over all who dwell in the kingdoms of earth and heaven, exalted above all beings, inaccessible above all who dwell in the kingdoms of earth and heaven, sovereign over all things, and supreme over all creation with power and independence.

order.why: Keep companionship and loss in a prayer about divine will.
Pray for the tree to bring forth the fruits of oneness.
Let heart, spirit, soul and body testify together.
shortened: My God beareth witness how that Branch from the branches of the tree of Thy love hath unified Thee through what Thou hast created in his essence of the truth of Thy unity, through his heart, spirit, soul, body and form.

order.why: Ask how the claim is tested by proof.
Keep the Bab’s reasoning about the Book and its evidence.
shortened: Look not upon the proofs, for all these are established by what God hath revealed in the Book, and naught can establish the Book save that which would render all on earth powerless, as they are unable to produce the like thereof. When the Cause hath reached unto God, look not upon your proofs, for all this hath been revealed by God.

order.why: Hear the response to the questioner who would test Him.
Read the prohibition on putting God to the test.
Consider wisdom beyond customary measures of value.
shortened: Say: O servants of God! He hath come with the knowledge of "He doeth what He willeth." Should He prefer an atom to the sun, or a drop to the ocean, all must accept it, for none knoweth the requirements of divine wisdom.

order.why: Keep the difficult relation of decree and human desire.
Let the confession of human unknowing humble certainty.
Distinguish uttering the words from recognizing their meaning.
shortened: This is the day of the manifestation of true divine unity. Blessed is the soul that hath recognized and laid hold on the hem of Him besides Whom there is none other God. In past ages and centuries this blessed word hath issued from the tongues of people, yet they remained heedless of its meaning and reality.

order.why: Hear the severe example of profession joined to persecution.
shortened: The people of the past never attained the fragrance of unity, much less its station. Each day they would ascribe a partner unto God, and yet deemed themselves to be believers in His unity.

After twelve hundred years of supplication, yearning, searching and hope, they martyred the Pride of the World and Lord of Nations with the most grievous torment. True unity is to turn unto the horizon of the one Manifestation; to exceed this is accounted as misbelief in the Book of God.

order.why: Ask how devotion itself may become a veil.
shortened: Beware, O people, lest ye be veiled from Him around Whose command unity itself doth circle, and be ye of the God-fearing.

How many there are who glorify and unify Him throughout all days and nights, yet are among the most heedless of servants, for they recognize not Him Whom they unify at morn and eventide. And how many a believer in divine unity is today a misbeliever before God, though he perceiveth it not within himself and is numbered among the idolaters.

order.why: Read unity through recognition of the Manifestation.
shortened: Say: O ignorant ones! O heedless ones! O oppressors! Your deeds and words on the day of reckoning deprived you of God's Most Great Name and the ocean of the All-Merciful's mercy. The oneness of God, exalted be His glory, is not established save through the Manifestation of His Self, the Dawning-Place of His Cause, the Dayspring of His Revelation, and His Representative among creation.

order.why: Keep the passage’s stated criterion of recognition.
Retain the warning against assigning peers.
Keep the claim of the Hidden One attributed.
Challenge attachment to names and inherited imaginings.
Read the confession as a decisive distinction.
shortened: Praise be to the Lord of all desire, Who is worthy and deserving, Who hath distinguished between the ungodly and the believers through the blessed word "There is none other God but God." This blessed word is the decisive utterance.

order.why: Keep the account of breaking idols within its historical praise.
Consider the promised transformation and its warnings.
shortened: Say: By God, all names have been transformed, the wailing of all things hath been raised up, and every soul hath been shaken, except those who have been quickened by the breathings of the All-Glorious that have wafted from the direction of your Lord, the All-Merciful, and awakened them from slumber and purified them from the defilement of the idolaters.

order.why: Retain the rebuke of heedlessness amid oppression.
Read the reported scriptural examples of power opposed to revelation.
Keep the commentary’s figures, judgment and promise together.
Turn purification of sight toward the promised Day.
shortened: Say: O people! Purify your vision and turn towards the Dayspring of lights. The Day hath come whereof God's messengers and prophets gave you tidings. Read ye what hath been sent down in the Tablets from God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Join recognition with nearness and meeting.
shortened: Say: O people of the earth! Fear ye the All-Merciful, and oppose not Him through Whom the sincere ones have soared unto the Kingdom of Meeting, and the pure in heart unto the heaven of nearness and reunion.

order.why: Hear the prison lament and invitation to mercy.
shortened: Glory be to Thee, O my God! Thou hearest my lamentation in this Prison and knowest that I have summoned the servants only to the court of Thy mercy and favors, and have commanded them only what Thou hast commanded in the kingdom of Thy decree and the dominion of Thy judgment.

order.why: Connect exclusive desire for God with courage.
Read the testimony of the Supreme Pen.
shortened: The Supreme Pen hath testified that there is none other God but Him, and that He is the One Who hath revealed Himself unto all things through His most beautiful names on the Day wherein the horizon of Divine Unity was illumined by the Sun of His Name, the All-Subduing Lord of all creation.

order.why: Listen to the Dove of Utterance.
shortened: Thus hath the Most Exalted Pen spoken, and the Dove of Utterance warbled upon the branch of knowledge that there is none other God but Him, the One Who, through His word, hath power over all things, the Mighty, the All-Wise.

order.why: Keep the rejoicing and lament in its revealed imagery.
shortened: I testify that through Thee the breezes of the All-Merciful have wafted through all contingent beings, and the Most Exalted Pen hath stirred amongst all religions, and the ocean of knowledge hath surged, and upon it hath sailed the Ark of the All-Merciful, through this Name at whose appearance the Concourse on High rejoiced and the idol that disbelieved in God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting, lamented."

order.why: Ask what steadfastness the image of fire demands.
Hear the assurance to one who hearkens.
Read resurrection’s signs through the creative Word.
Read light, fire and Moses through the declaration of oneness.
shortened: Praise be to God Who has manifested the Light and through it illumined the world of inner meanings and expression, and Who has revealed the Fire and through it shone forth upon Moses on the Mount of mystic knowledge.
There is none other God but Him. He has ever been in the heights of power and majesty, and in the summit of might and grandeur.

order.why: Receive the hidden beauty through its encompassing lights.
shortened: He is the Most Holy, the Most Great, the Most Glorious

Exalted be He Who hath revealed His Hidden Beauty with such lights as have encompassed the heavens and the earth, and hath caused every thing to voice the praise of the Dawning-Place of His Command when He came from the heaven of majesty with manifest sovereignty.

order.why: Hear the speaker calling others into remembrance.
shortened: Blessed is He Who hath spoken amidst the world and caused those near unto Him to speak forth in remembrance of His Most Great Name. He, verily, is the Omnipotent over whatsoever He willeth. There is none other God but Him, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Retain the intimate wish to conceal the beloved emblem.
Read the revealed testimony through knowledge, wisdom and loving-kindness.
shortened: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, and He Who hath come with the truth is verily the Ocean of My knowledge, the Heaven of My wisdom, and the Sun of My loving-kindness.

order.why: Hear the declaration addressed across religions.
shortened: This is a day wherein grace hath encompassed all religions, and the Divine Lott Tree hath called out from the Most Exalted Horizon: 'Verily, there is none other God but Him, the One, the Single, the All-Knowing.'

order.why: Consider the opening of what had been treasured.
Keep the question concerning evidence and revelation.
shortened: Say: Is there doubt about God, or about this Manifestation Who hath appeared with the truth with clear evidence, or about that which hath been revealed unto Him of the verses of your Lord, the All-Merciful?

order.why: Receive the proclamation addressed to a handmaiden.
Read the verses as a call to recognition.
Hold continuous revelation beside refusal.
shortened: The Sun of the Divine Countenance shines forth from the horizon of will, yet most turn away. The verses of the Lord descend at every moment from the heaven of merciful purpose, yet most of mankind remain veiled and remote therefrom.

order.why: Pause over the Fisher’s arresting image of attraction.
shortened: And how swift is this Fisher, who catches His prey before releasing the arrow - nay, in every instant brings a world of fishers into His net! With a single hair He has ensnared hundreds of thousands of necks, and with one glance from His eyelashes has wounded countless hearts.

order.why: Follow the call beyond names.
shortened: O Muhammad! Hearken to the call of the Single, the One! He called thee aforetime with a call whereby the believers took flight, the ungodly were thunderstruck, and the sincere hastened to the dawning-place of thy Lord's Most Exalted Beauty, and then the near ones to a station wherefrom all mention and names were cut off.

order.why: Hear sovereignty through the speaking Kingdom.
shortened: We verily behold the Kingdom - it speaketh and saith: "O people of the Realm of Might! By God, the King of Kings hath come with a sovereignty that hath encompassed all who are in existence.

order.why: Retain the concise declaration of spiritual oneness.
shortened: O 'Ali-Haydar, praise be to God that thou hast turned unto Him and acknowledged the oneness of God, exalted be His glory. Blessed are they who attain unto this most exalted and glorious station. This is the station of true divine unity and spiritual oneness.

order.why: Consider remembrance appearing in the Youth.
shortened: Thus hath the matter been decreed, but the people are in a mighty veil. And verily His remembrance hath appeared in the temple of the Youth. Blessed be God, the Best of creators!

order.why: Hear the call addressed to the people of the Bayan.
Read the enthronement through its encompassing names.
shortened: The Throne hath appeared and there hath sat upon it the Temple of God, Lord of the unseen and the seen. And at the first moment of His sitting, He shed His effulgence upon all things through all names.

order.why: Keep the first-person divine claim within revealed speech.
Listen to testimony calling the earth toward oneness.
Join raised standards with revealed commandments.
shortened: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him, and He Who speaketh is indeed the One through Whom the standards of divine unity were raised above all other standards and through Whom appeared the commandments of God, the Lord of the worlds.

order.why: Let a personal witness answer the primordial testimony.
Read law as drawing near and avoiding veils.
Receive the assurance of attained illumination.
shortened: Praise be to God that thou hast attained and hast been illumined with the lights of the Word of Divine Unity.

order.why: Ask why descending verses may pass unperceived.
Pray for hearing and sight that can help others gain access.
shortened: We beseech Him to raise up those possessed of acute hearing and keen sight who may, through witnessing, observing and hearkening, attain, and may enlighten the people on behalf of God, glorified be His majesty, so that all may gain access to the ocean of utterance and remain not deprived of the horizon of manifestation.

order.why: Return to oneness in the Fire Tablet’s prayer of aloneness.
shortened: By Thine aloneness the Sun of Oneness shone, and by Thy banishment the land of Unity was adorned. Be patient, O Thou Exile of the worlds.

order.why: Enter the ocean of joy.
Read surrender as a practical expression of unity.
shortened: The station of absolute self-surrender transcendeth, and will ever remain exalted above, every other station.

It behoveth thee to consecrate thyself to the Will of God. Whatsoever hath been revealed in His Tablets is but a reflection of His Will. So complete must be thy consecration, that every trace of worldly desire will be washed from thine heart. This is the meaning of true unity.

order.why: Ask for opened eyes.
Seek protection through eternal oneness.
shortened: Shield us, then, O my God, from the mischief of Thine enemies, and assist us to help Thy Faith, and to protect Thy Cause, and to celebrate Thy glory. Thou art, verily, He Who from everlasting hath inhabited the inaccessible heights of His unity, and will continue to remain the same for ever and ever.

order.why: Remember grace preceding created things.
shortened: O my God! Thou art He Whose mercy hath preceded all things, Whose grace hath encompassed all, Whose proof hath been perfected, Whose evidence hath been completed, Whose sovereignty hath appeared, Whose power hath become manifest, Who hath perfected for Thy servants Thy manifest Faith, Who hath extended Thy straight Path, and made manifest Thy righteous Way.

order.why: Pray for mercy through the opened gate.
Let love and servitude deepen the prayer.
Ask for certainty beyond conjecture.
shortened: I ask Thee, O my God, by Thy Power, Might and Dominion which have encompassed all who are in Thy heaven and earth--to point out to Thy servants Thy straight pathway, that they may acknowledge Thy Oneness and singleness with a certainty that shall not be clouded by the imaginations of doubters, nor veiled by the conjectures of straying wanderers.

order.why: Offer testimony through the tongue.
Pray for hearts purified for undivided worship.
Journey through the images of ocean, river and garden.
shortened: Strengthen Thy sincere servants to walk in the pathways of Thy good-pleasure and to tread the ways that lead to Thy contentment, to plunge into the ocean of Thy oneness and to draw from the river of Thy sanctity, to enter the paradise of Thy uniqueness and to speak forth Thy remembrance and praise, to become intoxicated with the wine of Thy knowledge and to gather the fruits from the garden of Thy bounty.

order.why: Hold fast to the cord of oneness.
shortened: O my Lord! These are Thy loved ones who have held fast to the cord of Thy oneness and clung to the hem of Thy singleness.

order.why: Join oneness with immersion and detachment.
Extend the blessing to fellow witnesses.
Receive unity through the image of a shared feast.
shortened: O divine friends! Having adorned the food of glory and submission with the spices of unity and sanctification, enter into the verdant, joyous shallow waters of the Beloved Lord, veiled with the veil of light.

order.why: Let praise join the proclamation of all things.
shortened: There is no God but Him, the Single, the Most Exalted, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.
Blessed is he who hath opened his lips in praise of his Lord in these days wherein all things have proclaimed that there is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Generous.

order.why: Keep the community’s concise confession.
shortened: We testify that there is none other God but Him, in acknowledgment of His oneness and confession of His singleness. There is none other God but Him, the One, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Pray for all to be illumined.
Receive detachment as a fruit of true unity.
shortened: Blessed is the soul that hath attained unto true unity and become detached and free from all else but God.

order.why: Return remembrance to life on earth.
shortened: O Muhammad qabl-i-Hasan! Fix thy gaze upon this blessed Word, which is even as the Most Great Luminary for the world of vision: "Make mention of Me on My earth, and I will make mention of thee in My heaven."

order.why: Keep the martyr’s letter and services in view.
Remember the named person in the proclamation.
Hear Sinai’s response to unity.
shortened: The Sinai hath smiled in this Revelation whereby the standards of idolatry were lowered and the banners of divine unity were raised by the command of God, the Lord of all existence.

order.why: Answer the testimony and call.
shortened: Blessed is he who hath drawn nigh and perceived the fragrance of the Garment and testified to that whereunto God did testify before the creation of the heavens and earth that there is none other God but Him, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
We have heard thy call and have remembered thee in this Tablet which proclaimeth throughout the world that there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

order.why: Let the divine spring prompt a response.
Notice steadfast growth while vain traces disappear.
Link unity with adherence and action.
Remember those through whom the standard was raised.
shortened: Through them was raised the standard of divine unity upon the heights, and the fragrance of the garment was wafted amongst the peoples.

order.why: Follow unveiled beauty into remembrance and joy.
Read the illumination of a darkened world.
Pray that the fruit of unity become evident.
shortened: May eternal bounty become universal, and may witnessed unity culminate in existential uniqueness, and may the fruit of essential unity become manifest and evident.

order.why: Consider revelation as renewing the human world.
Ask the sheltered souls to become resplendent stars.
shortened: O thou who hast turned to the Abha kingdom!

At this time when the effulgence of that Self-Subsisting Sun [Baha'u'llah] hath from the unseen aspect of existence cast its rays across the earth and heaven and irradiated the farthest horizons with its dawning lights of primal unity, such souls as have sought shelter beneath His all embracing Word should themselves become as resplendent stars.

order.why: Recognize the mysteries made evident.
shortened: Praise be to God, the lights of oneness are shining and the mysteries of divine unity are manifest and evident.

order.why: Read truth through lamp and niche.
Let the removal of imagination open hearing and sight.
Consider the promised spread of unity.
Receive the overflowing light of a new age.
Keep the many symbolic birds within one proclamation.
Value spiritual unity between hearts as a blessing.
Let recognition make people sources of mercy and concord.
Turn the cloud of love toward good deeds.
shortened: These are they who have mounted the cloud of love and speed through the atmosphere of the spirit. These are they for whom the word of immortality hath been fulfilled, and who abide forever in the heaven of holiness. They pay no heed to aught else but hasten to do good deeds and walk the paths of truth.

order.why: Join justice, truthfulness and right action.
Let remembrance lead into service.
Pray for steadfastness and the strength to serve.
shortened: I testify that the ocean of Thy bounty surgeth throughout existence, and the signs of Thy manifestation have encompassed both the unseen and the seen. I beseech Thee by Thy Most Exalted Word, through whose appearance all things have acknowledged Thy unity and singleness, and by the pearls of the ocean of Thy generosity and the dawning lights of the Orb of Thy bestowal, to aid Thy loved ones to be steadfast in Thy love and to arise to serve Thee.

order.why: Keep the specific prayer for the Sultan and illumined hearts.
Pray for the community’s protection.
shortened: Praise be to God, the fragrance of confession to the word of unity was wafted therefrom. Today it behooveth all to beseech God, exalted be His glory, to protect the community of the merciful and to guard those who believe in His unity, through the hosts of the seen and the unseen, from the evil of the ungodly.

order.why: Bring divine unity into human society.
Read connection and harmony as characteristics of the cycle.
Ask people to exemplify oneness together.
Pray that thoughts and feelings diffuse accord.
shortened: O Lord, cause our souls to depend upon the signs of Thy Oneness, our hearts to be dilated with the Bounties of Thy Singleness, so that we may become united as are ripples on a waving sea; become harmonized as are the rays which shine forth from a brilliant light; so that our thoughts, opinions and feelings become as one reality from which the spirit of accord may be diffused throughout all regions.

order.why: Contrast unity’s building with discord’s destruction.
Close the linked readings with service that brings light.
Retain the separately supplied account of knowledge and transcendence.
Keep the provisional warning against taking two as one.
shortened: By belief in the unity of God it is not meant that two are to be seen as one: this is the essence of godlessness and of joining partners with God. Nay, by belief in the unity of God is meant that God is to be considered in every respect to be one and sanctified above all names and comparisons; and that all else save Him have been raised up by Him and have their being through His command.

order.why: End with the supplied distinction between existential and manifestational oneness.

questions: How does the compilation distinguish divine unity from numerical oneness or the identification of Creator and creation?
What do its images of the sun, mirrors, names, and signs make understandable, and where do the passages ask us to acknowledge the limits of those images?
How do the unity of the Manifestations and the differences of their historical appearances illuminate one another?
What changes when negation, affirmation, and the limits of description are encountered in prayer rather than only as philosophical propositions?
How do Qur’an 112 and Mark’s conversation about the greatest commandment illuminate different aspects of transcendence, devotion, and relationship?
What forms of service, justice, or concord might express divine unity in a community, and how could its members examine the gap between profession and conduct?

references.label: 1 · Qur’an 112:1–4 · Incomparable oneness
references.note: Read all four verses using the verse links. The surah declares divine oneness and dependence upon God while denying begetting, birth, and any equal. Compare this compact confession with the compilation’s extended efforts to distinguish the divine Essence from everything created and conceivable.

references.label: 2 · Mark 12:28–34 · Oneness and the greatest commandment
references.note: Jesus answers the scribe with the confession of one Lord and the commands to love God wholly and one’s neighbor as oneself. The scribe places such love above sacrificial offerings. Consider this exchange beside the compilation’s insistence that the affirmation of unity become visible in the whole person and in shared life, while attending to the Gospel’s own setting.

subjects.displayTitle: The believer’s station: dignity expressed through service
subjects.introduction: You are better known in the Kingdom on high than you are to yourselves, Bahá’u’lláh tells His loved ones, and the words are meant to unsettle. A person the chiefs of the people count poor and small may be, at the Threshold of the King of existence, great and renowned; a single hair of such a soul outweighs what the world prizes. Much of this assurance is addressed to women, whose standing before God is set against every queen’s longing. Yet the station is never a possession. Its crown is servitude, its sovereignty is dust at the threshold of the friends, and it must be preserved by truthfulness, kindness, freedom from prejudice and steadfastness under trial, so that a stranger entering a city would recognise a Bahá’í by conduct alone. Mark’s account of greatness measured by serving [1] and First Peter’s chosen people whose good works others can see [2] test the same claim from within another tradition. The journey continues toward the Crimson Ark in which such souls are gathered, the angels they are likened to, the high station of those who teach the Cause, and the greatness of the Day that confers it.
subjects.arc: Open with hidden worth and visible character; ground distinction in grace and service; read personal assurances and the dignity of women against worldly rank; follow recognition through trials, steadfastness and enduring influence; end with the life that makes belief credible.

order.why: Open with being better known than one knows oneself.
shortened: I swear by Him Who hath caused Me to reveal whatever hath pleased Him! Ye are better known to the inmates of the Kingdom on high than ye are known to your own selves. Think ye these words to be vain and empty? Would that ye had the power to perceive the things your Lord, the All-Merciful, doth see---things that attest the excellence of your rank, that bear witness to the greatness of your worth, that proclaim the sublimity of your station!

order.why: Give that hidden dignity an observable ethical test.
shortened: Should any one of you enter a city, he should become a centre of attraction by reason of his sincerity, his faithfulness and love, his honesty and fidelity, his truthfulness and loving-kindness towards all the peoples of the world, so that the people of that city may cry out and say: 'This man is unquestionably a Baha'i, for his manners, his behaviour, his conduct, his morals, his nature, and disposition reflect the attributes of the Baha'is.' Not until ye attain this station can ye be said to have been faithful to the Covenant and Testament of God.

order.why: Define spiritual honor through humility and service.
shortened: It is incumbent upon thee to be humble, lowly and submissive at the appearance of the lights of the gifts of thy Lord, in every instant. Serve the friends of God under all circumstances and conditions. This is the station of the spiritual ones; this is the honor of the Bahais; this is the glory of the sincere ones and this is the sovereignty of the believers.

order.why: Attribute every station to grace rather than personal capacity.
shortened: Praise be to God that whenever you attain any station, you recognize it as from the bounties of the Blessed Beauty and not from your own capacity and capability - and this is the best character and most pleasant virtue.

order.why: Set spiritual honor beyond poverty, wealth and social power.
shortened: These souls are truly honoured, these souls will abide in the grace of God, be they rich or poor, be they captive or a prince.

order.why: Reject contempt toward those deemed lowly.
Contrast public insignificance with spiritual worth.
Let belonging coexist with confessed unworthiness.
Identify the promised station with divine good-pleasure.
shortened: The Promised Beauty hath destined so exalted a station for His loved ones that it is the envy and the highest wish of the holy saints among His chosen Ones. That station consists of naught else but the attainment of the good pleasure of God, utterance of His praise and glorification within His sanctified Court. In such a station, one shall attract divine assistance, and be the object of the glance of God's mercy; one shall be aided and confirmed by His strengthening grace.

order.why: Read servitude as shared glory.
shortened: 'Abdu'l-Baha's eternal glory is servitude at the Sacred Threshold, and the handmaidens of the All-Merciful's everlasting blessing is service at the Court of Oneness. We are all gathered beneath the shade of that praiseworthy station.

order.why: Turn the crown into an image of service.
shortened: Today the greatest gift of God and the noblest state of human perfection is servitude at the holy threshold of Oneness. This servitude is a glorious diadem and a resplendent crown.

order.why: Consider sovereignty expressed by serving the friends.
Locate the sovereignty in the inner world.
shortened: O servant of the Ancient Beauty! Though thou art His servant, yet art thou the master of the world, for thou art the devoted bondsman of the Abha Beauty, the King of Kings. That is, thou dost exercise sovereignty in the inner world and rulest over the realm of meanings. Thou art seated upon the throne of glory and grandeur, and dwellest in the lofty palaces of sovereignty.

order.why: Read freedom alongside spiritual servitude.
Keep the inversion of service and sovereignty.
shortened: This is not servitude but sovereignty, and this is not service but chieftainship and greatness! This is the garment of everlasting glory with which thou hast clothed thyself, and this is the rose of eternal exaltation with which thou hast adorned thy head.

order.why: Extend distinction to every virtue and every human being.
shortened: In brief, you must become distinguished in all the virtues of the human world -- for faithfulness and sincerity, for justice and fidelity, for firmness and steadfastness, for philanthropic deeds and service to the human world, for love toward every human being, for unity and accord with all people, for removing prejudices and promoting international peace.

order.why: Let fairness and kindness establish trust among all people.
shortened: Moreover, they must associate with all people with the utmost kindliness and conduct themselves with perfect sanctity, detachment, truthfulness and fairness, in such wise that all people may regard them as the trustees of God amongst His servants.
Consider carefully what station the friends of God must move in, and in what atmosphere they must soar.

order.why: Ask that knowing one’s worth prevent wasted effort.
shortened: O friends! Know ye your worth and station. Waste not your endeavors on the idle fancies of this one and that. Ye are the stars of the heaven of understanding and the breezes of the morn. Ye are the living waters upon which dependeth the life of all, and ye are the letters of the Book.

order.why: Connect appreciating the gift with rising to its demands.
shortened: O friends, know who ye are and what ye are! Ye are the friends of Baha u llah ! Ye are the lovers of the Beauty of God. Appreciate this high station and rise to attain that which is worthy of this bounty.

order.why: Keep conduct as the condition of an unimaginable station.
shortened: Were one to live in accord with these teachings, no one can predict the loftiness of his station. It is beyond the computation of human imagination.

order.why: Hear the claim of a station concealed by a veil.
Consider the limits of the world’s capacity to bear revelation.
shortened: O Kamal! Today the stations of divine favors are veiled, for the realm of existence hath not had, nor hath it now, the capacity to bear their revelation. But soon will He manifest His Cause by His behest.

order.why: Keep the personal assurance and its unsettling effect.
shortened: I swear by Him Who is the Eternal Truth! Through thee the eyes of the inmates of the Exalted Paradise have been gladdened. The people, however, are utterly heedless. Were We to reveal thy station, the hearts of men would be sorely agitated, their footsteps would slip, the embodiments of vainglory would be dumbfounded, would fall down upon the ground, and would thrust the fingers of heedlessness into their ears, for fear of hearing.

order.why: Notice that recipients themselves may remain unaware.
shortened: Strange it is that even such souls remain unaware of their stations, for such is the bounty vouchsafed unto them that were but a glimmer thereof to become manifest, the earth would be transformed into another earth.

order.why: Read renown beyond one’s immediate circle.
shortened: By Him Who has caused Me to speak what He desires - your names are more renowned in the Supreme Kingdom than your mention among yourselves.

order.why: Include women and men in the gift beyond description.
Keep the particular address to Haydar-Ali.
Acknowledge the limit of mystical comprehension.
shortened: By Him Who is the All-Knowing One of the world and the Beloved of the world, there is ordained for such souls a station that neither the minds of the wise nor the understanding of the mystics can comprehend.

order.why: Let the pens of nations fall short.
shortened: I swear by the ocean of the All-Merciful's utterance that such souls possess a station which the Book of the world and the pens of nations are powerless to describe.

order.why: Keep the statement of an incomprehensible station.
shortened: O people of Baha! By the Lord of Names I swear, a station hath been ordained for you the like of which no one hath understood or shall understand.

order.why: Ask what it means to become cognizant of one’s station.
shortened: By My life and by My life, for each one of them a great station hath been ordained. Blessed are the souls who in the divine days have attained and become cognizant of their stations.

order.why: Read equal standing alongside the joy of concealed faith.
shortened: By the life of God, these souls were and are the most exalted of creation, and all are, in the sight of God, on the same plane. Were the station of faith to be made manifest today, all the sincere ones, the near ones, and the believers would perish from joy and gladness.

order.why: Hear the paired blessing of servant and handmaiden.
shortened: Well is it with the man-servant who hath attained, and with the maid-servant who hath attained, unto this most exalted, most holy, most glorious station.

order.why: Keep both women and men in the promise.
shortened: Whosoever today attains to this most great bounty and most generous favor - if she be among the handmaidens, she is mentioned before God as being among the denizens of the highest chambers of Paradise, and if he be among the men, he is accounted as one of the people of the Ridvan.

order.why: Compare spiritual worth with accumulated riches.
Read a single breath against earthly treasures.
shortened: By the righteousness of the one true God! The very breath of these souls is in itself richer than all the treasures of the earth. Happy is the man that hath attained thereunto, and woe betide the heedless.

order.why: Keep the incomparable value stated for steadfastness.
shortened: Whoso is established in this Cause - all that hath been created between the heavens and earth cannot equal him.

order.why: Retain the emphatic claim for a single soul.
Keep the comparison with earlier peoples in its revealed setting.
Read the single soul through recognition of the promised Day.
shortened: Consider now how glorious is the station of one who hath attained unto this most great bounty and supreme grace. I swear by the pearls of the divine ocean of wisdom that a single accepted soul is mightier and greater than all the peoples of the world, for all were created to recognize this most holy and sublime Day, and in all the scriptures the appearance of this mighty Cause was promised; yet they are seen to be deprived and debarred therefrom.

order.why: Consider one pure soul’s possible influence.
shortened: O thou who art a true gentleman! Be thou a man of the world. How often it hath come to pass that a single person representeth a thousand souls. Every soul that is firm in the Faith of God prevaileth in human perfections over thousands. One brilliant jewel excelleth a thousand pieces of rock, and one illumined heart is preferable to a thousand darkened hearts. Therefore one pure soul is equal to a world of men.

order.why: Ask how acceptance changes the value of deeds and words.
Retain the exalted description of guides in its source context.
Keep the demanding image of an encompassing shadow attributed.
shortened: Know thou that unless thou seest all who are in the heavens and on earth under thy shadow, thou wilt never be able to enter the land that hath encompassed all things. This is the truth, whereupon the Pen of ancient holiness hath moved, for this is a Revelation the like of which the eye of days hath never witnessed, if thou be of them that see.

order.why: Turn the eyes toward the Beauty for which they were created.
shortened: O Eyes of this Temple!  Look not upon the heavens and that which they contain, nor upon the earth and them that dwell thereon, for We have created you to behold Our own Beauty:  See it now before you!  Withhold not your gaze therefrom, and deprive not yourselves of the Beauty of your Lord, the All-Glorious, the Best-Beloved.

order.why: Read the Bab’s description of undivided desire.
Receive new life through opened eyes, ears and hearts.
shortened: From amongst all mankind hath He chosen you, and your eyes have been opened to the light of guidance and your ears attuned to the music of the Company above; and blessed by abounding grace, your hearts and souls have been born into new life. Thank ye and praise ye God that the hand of infinite bestowals hath set upon your heads this gem-studded crown, this crown whose lustrous jewels will forever flash and sparkle down all the reaches of time.

order.why: Follow the lifted veil into clearer vision.
Join discernment with truthful hearing.
shortened: Open thou the eye of true discernment so as to see for thyself the blazing fire kindled on Sinai, and open the ear of truth that thou mayest hearken to the call of the divine Beloved summoning thee from the Supreme Horizon.

order.why: Read eye and ear oriented toward the Kingdom.
shortened: And thine eye, which gazeth upon the Abha Kingdom, pierceth all veils. And thine ear, which is turned toward the Supreme Realm, is intimate with the angel of revelation.

order.why: Contrast paper and ink with the perception of meaning.
Keep names from hiding their source.
Read recognition beyond religious leadership and inherited imaginings.
Let recognition prompt thanksgiving rather than self-congratulation.
Observe the reversal of assumed learning and rank.
Keep the same reversal in a personal address.
Read the contrast of worldly nobility and reaching the goal.
shortened: O pure-hearted servant of the Lord God! The nobles of the world took the path of nothingness, while you trod the way of the Ancient Beauty and took shelter in the shadow of the Most Great Name. Every noble ultimately failed, but you, like an unerring arrow, reached the goal.

order.why: Hear a call accepted when scholars turned away.
shortened: Thou art he who hearkened unto the call of thy Lord and turned unto Him on a day when every doubting scholar turned away. Blessed art thou for having turned towards Him, drawn nigh unto Him, hearkened and drunk from the cup of the bounty of thy Lord, the All-Bountiful.

order.why: Keep the response to the call in its particular day.
shortened: Thou art he who heard the Call and responded to thy Lord, the Lord of Names, when the peoples turned away from Him save whom God, the Lord of the worlds, did will.

order.why: Read that response as recorded in the divine Book.
shortened: I swear by the effulgent rays of the Sun of Truth that whosoever attained and, at the time of the raising of the Call, was confirmed in responding - such a one is recorded and inscribed among the dwellers of the highest paradise in the divine Book.

order.why: Remember hearing revelation in the prison of Akka.
Keep the blessing of turning toward the Intended One.
shortened: Blessed art thou for having turned towards the Intended One and turned away from him who turned away from God when He came with manifest sovereignty.

order.why: Refuse to let general refusal determine one’s response.
Read turning as answered by revelation.
shortened: We beheld thee turning unto the Countenance, whereupon We turned unto thee and revealed for thee that which God hath made a testimony unto all who are in the heavens and on earth.

order.why: Connect recognition with being remembered.
shortened: Whosoever has attained unto recognition is reckoned with God and is mentioned by the Supreme Pen in the Book of God.

order.why: Join seeing the promised Day with following its counsel.
shortened: This is the Day whose mention caused the Messengers of old to rejoice, as attested by every Book which the All-Merciful hath sent down from His wondrous kingdom. Blessed is he who, endowed with vision, hath beheld the Most Great Panorama and followed that which was ordained by the Ordainer, the Ancient of Days.

order.why: Read the path through the requirement of vision.
shortened: This is the straight path which, in this Revelation of the Great Announcement, hath been made clear and manifest to all the peoples of the world - that is, to them that are endowed with vision.

order.why: Hold recognition and action together.
Keep the testimony to the Bab and the coming of Baha.
Pass beyond words into awareness of received bounty.
Read guidance through the feast of the primordial covenant.
shortened: For you have been confirmed in the cause of the creation of all beings and have been made successful in attaining the greatest guidance. You have drunk the cup of favors from the hand of the Cup-bearer at the feast of "Am I not your Lord?", and you have partaken of the wine of life from the wine-cellar of love for the Most Glorious Beauty. You have entered the circle of His chosen ones and become among the enthralled lovers of the Divine Beloved.

order.why: Follow detachment into recognition and remembrance.
shortened: Verily, they who have ascended unto God and turned away from earthly dominion, and have drunk from the ocean of life - these are they who recognize the melodies of Paradise and bear witness that all this is a revelation from the presence of One Who is the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting. These are they from whose faces radiance doth shine forth, and from whose hearts the remembrance of God is heard, and who have been enraptured in the atmosphere of the spirit by the melodies of God.

order.why: Receive the cup from those whose faces have turned toward God.
Keep the Khidr image in its stated setting.
shortened: O you who are firm in the Covenant! The fountain of the water of life is the very essence of guidance. Praise be to God, you have drunk thereof, and every one who drinks becomes the Khidr of the time.

order.why: Read Majnun’s consuming love beside the prophetic charge of madness.
Let the address handmaiden define a noble title.
Explore the difference between that address and worldly titles.
Receive the same address as a reason for gratitude.
Keep its stated value beyond an offered possession.
Join receiving the address with preserving its station.
shortened: O leaf! Praise the Beloved of the worlds that thou hast attained unto His blessed word "O My handmaiden." It behooveth thee to preserve this most exalted station through the name of thy Lord, the Most Glorious.

order.why: Consider what fulfilling servitude asks in practice.
Ask the handmaiden to become a sign of guidance.
shortened: O handmaid of the Lord! If thou desirest everlasting glory, arise to fulfill the conditions of servitude, for the handmaids of the Blessed Beauty must each one be a sign of guidance and a manifestation of the Most Great Bounty.

order.why: Connect service to God with service to His loved ones.
shortened: O two maidservants of the loved ones of God! It befits you to glory and boast over the queens of all regions, for yours is an everlasting, eternal sovereignty in that you have attained to servitude to the Most Glorious Beauty and service to the chosen ones of God. This servitude to the Ancient Beauty is service to His loved ones.

order.why: Contrast outward lowliness with the dignity of women before God.
Retain women’s recognition amid men’s failure to recognize.
Receive women as mighty signs and leaves of the Tree.
Read sacrificial service as a source of guidance.
Follow a woman’s service into enduring influence.
shortened: But every maidservant of God who has spread the divine fragrances, served the Kingdom of God, and proclaimed the Word of God - her influence continues to rise and spread throughout the ages. Her dawn is radiant, her star is brilliant, her banner is waving, her station is lofty, her crown gleams, her melody chants forth, her fame spreads far and wide, her voice resounds, her spirit soars in the highest paradise and her light shines in the Supreme Horizon.

order.why: Hear the promise of glorious deeds extending through ages.
shortened: She shall surely have a firm and steady footing in the Cause of God, her face shall shine forth from the Horizon of Loftiness, her fame shall be spread in the Kingdom of God, and [she] shall have a ringing voice throughout regions, and the lights of her glorious deeds shall beam forth during cycles and ages.

order.why: Read women raising the banner of love.
Value their devoted care at the Threshold.
shortened: O handmaidens of the All-Merciful! Praise be to God that ye are cherished maidservants at the Threshold of Oneness and devoted attendants and guardians of the Sacred Court. What glory and pride could be greater than this?

order.why: Let the surging sea convey favors beyond expression.
Keep the concise assurance of being numbered among believing women.
shortened: Praise be to God that you are numbered among the believing women in the presence of the Divine Countenance, and counted among those who have turned towards Him.

order.why: Receive acceptance at the court of mercy.
shortened: Within the precincts of His divine sanctuary ye have been chosen from among His servants and in the court of His mercy ye have been accepted among His handmaidens.

order.why: Give thanks for the light already appearing.
shortened: Now you, O confident leaves, arise in thanksgiving that, praise be to God, you have the stars of this manifest light rising from the horizon of your brow and the appearance of these brilliant traces manifest in your radiant reality. You wear the crown of this grace upon your head and the diadem of this bounty upon your brow.

order.why: Read the invitation to witnessing and refinement.
shortened: Attain to the station of witnessing, for you have become cherished maidservants at the Divine Threshold, have become cultured and refined, and have become intoxicated and ecstatic from the overflowing cup.

order.why: Retain the personal gift of a crown of knowledge.
shortened: O handmaiden of the merciful Lord! God has placed the crown of divine knowledge upon your head and granted you superiority over all the women of the world.

order.why: Distinguish present comparison from a value yet to appear.
Read servitude against the longing of worldly nobility.
Keep the leaves of the Tree beside the queens’ longing.
Continue the contrast of worldly strength and received intimacy.
Notice that a station’s value may not yet be known.
Keep grace as the basis of the comparison with royal privilege.
Hear the long yearning of women before this Day.
shortened: O thou illumined leaf!

A hundred thousand maidservants, who for countless years engaged in divers arduous devotions, and who, with fervent longing and tearful lamentation, supplicated the threshold of Divine Oneness that they might live for but a moment in these Days and perceive the merest glimmer of the Sinaitic fire, expired at last in the wilderness of separation, and, with infinite regret, laid down their lives in love's arena.

order.why: Receive attainment against that history of longing.
Identify the enduring station with nearness.
Retain the severe warning about fruitless lives.
Keep the image of faithful women as morning stars.
shortened: All became absolute nothingness and utter non-existence, and shall continue so, except for those gems of sanctity who shone forth like morning stars at the dawn of creation - namely, those women who were dawning-places of the signs of faithfulness and who, with pure hearts and radiant faces, turned toward the Manifestation of "were it not for Thee."

order.why: Look toward remembrance that consoles future generations.
shortened: It behooveth thee to render a thousand thanks at every moment for the bounty of being thus crowned with the diadem of the most great guidance, and it befitteth thee to pride thyself above all the queens of the world. For thousands of worldly queens shall come and go, leaving behind neither name nor trace, neither sign nor fruit; but through the light of Godis love thou wilt shine forth above the horizon of eternity and thy remembrance will bring solace to the hearts of men and women in ages and centuries to come.

order.why: Contrast sitting on dust with the promise of honor.
shortened: Thou, however, and other maidservants of God like unto thee, though ye be seated on the dust, are, in the eyes of God, established upon the seats of honour; and when finally ye return unto your Lord, ye shall ascend with matchless glory unto the realms above. Then shall the whole sublime and holy company of the maids of heaven come forth to greet you, and inhale from you the sweet savours of the love of God.

order.why: Hear the promise of companionship in the heavenly Kingdom.
shortened: O ye maid-servants of the Merciful! verily, your Lord, the Supreme, is calling upon you from His Ancient Kingdom and announces unto you such glad-tidings, whereat the hearts of the angels of heaven rejoice.
Then ye will become the angels of heaven, will enter among the Supreme Concourse and will permanently abide in the paradise of union (with God), and will be associated with the Beauty of El-ABHA.

order.why: Keep the particular leaf and others who honor her station.
Connects the perfection of faith and spiritual glory with self-sacrifice.
Read the registration of handmaidens among the near ones.
shortened: Each of the leaves and handmaidens who hath today turned towards the Truth is recorded and inscribed among the near ones in the Book of God.

order.why: Link meeting with the image of a leaf.
Ask how awareness of this station would shape praise.
Remember women whose recognition withstood opposition.
Compare vanishing royal pomp with enduring spiritual light.
shortened: The pomp of the kings of the world is a vanishing mirage, and the pageantry and magnificence of every renowned prince is a fleeting shadow. But the faces of the loved ones, illumined by the light of the favors of the One True God, shall shine resplendent throughout all eternity.

order.why: Keep the reported distinction between temporal and spiritual sovereignty.
shortened: In speaking of the kings and queens of earth, Abdul-Baha said: "Their glory is but temporal and mortal, for they are but rules of this ephemeral sphere, where all things change from day to day and finally pass away entirely: But the women and men who in the time of a divine Manifestation come forward to acknowledge and believe in Him become real kings and queens, whose reign, glory and dominion are immortal.

order.why: Read the reported comparison with Queen Victoria in its historical setting.
shortened: "Queen Victoria was a great woman, but what do you hear of her now, after these few years! But upon your head God has placed an eternal crown. He has bestowed upon you eternal sovereignty. He has given you eternal life!"

order.why: Follow the lasting fruit of disciples without fortune or position.
shortened: But those who have been servants of the divine beauty are never forgotten. The result of their works is everywhere visible. What king is there of two thousand years ago whose kingdom has lived in the hearts? But those disciples who were devoted to God, poor people who had neither fortune nor position, are today trees bearing fruit. Their banner is raised higher every day.

order.why: Consider the reported image of first fruits.
Read early believers’ future influence through the apostles’ example.
shortened: The full measure of your success is as yet unrevealed, its significance still unapprehended. Erelong ye will, with your own eyes, witness how brilliantly every one of you, even as a shining star, will radiate in the firmament of your country the light of divine Guidance, and will bestow upon its people the glory of an everlasting life.

The station and the confirmation of the apostles in the time of Christ was not known, and no one looked on them with the feeling of importance--nay, rather, they persecuted and ridiculed them. Later on it became evident what crowns studded with the brilliant jewels of guidance were placed on the heads of the apostles, Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of John.

order.why: Imagine believers as spring breezes that change the world.
Read their light through the image of the ark.
shortened: Blessed are the people of Bahá! God beareth Me witness! They are the solace of the eye of creation. Through them the universes have been adorned, and the Preserved Tablet embellished. They are the ones who have sailed on the ark of complete independence, with their faces set towards the Dayspring of Beauty. How great is their blessedness that they have attained unto what their Lord, the Omniscient, the All-Wise, hath willed. Through their light the heavens have been adorned, and the faces of those that have drawn nigh unto Him made to shine.

order.why: Keep the Crimson Ark linked to its stated scriptural source.
Retain the testimony of the Supreme Pen concerning the ark.
Read belonging through branches of the same Tree.
Consider the tree’s loftiness through its branches.
Follow the garden’s fragrance outward.
Read stars of understanding beside fruits of Paradise.
shortened: Blessed are they who, for the sake of God, have borne hardships and heard the taunts of the enemies.
By the ocean of divine knowledge! Such souls are as stars in the heaven of understanding and as fruits upon the trees of Paradise.

order.why: Consider the many images of guidance and mercy.
Receive a prayer for compassionate and godly friends.
Bring heavenly qualities into simple public education.
Let the ideals of benefactors rise above their age.
shortened: They are the real benefactors of humanity, the burning torches of bright hope. Just as the heaven is above the earth, so their Ideals must soar above the ideals of this age.

order.why: Keep the reported description of the Tehran friends as angels.
Read enduring work through seed and writing.
shortened: But the friends of God are under the shade and protection of Baha'u'llah. They sow their seed in firm ground. They write upon the surface of iron and steel. That is when they father many harvests and their writings bestow eternal significances.

order.why: Look for spiritual effects even in the world of dust.
Turn attention toward the leaves of the Divine Tree.
Consider the ever-rising light of steadfast faces.
Keep the promise to the sons and daughters of the Kingdom.
shortened: But the sons and daughters of the Kingdom ultimately become brilliant lamps and radiant stars in the horizon of eternal glory.

order.why: Consider remembrance shining like a star.
shortened: Today man is able to attain such a station that his remembrance, like a star in the heaven of God's Tablet, may shine bright and radiant through the eternity of His names and attributes.

order.why: Read the crown through its future radiance.
shortened: I swear by that bright countenance of His and that beautiful brow, ye are so adorned that the pearls and jewels of your crowns shall gleam across the centuries and ages of the future.

order.why: Retain the comparison between kings and the enduring crown.
shortened: And to this station kings are but slaves, and monarchs are but helpless subjects. The grace of the Most Great Name hath placed upon the heads of the faithful friends a precious crown whose brilliant jewels shall illumine centuries and ages.

order.why: Locate the prince’s sovereignty within the soul.
Keep the throne and crown in their spiritual setting.
shortened: O servant of Baha! Praise be to God that a crown from the glorious Kingdom rests upon the heads of the friends, and the eternal throne of sovereignty in that world is the felicity of the friends.

order.why: Hear the promise of enduring remembrance.
Let trial reveal what appearance conceals.
shortened: But in the time of trials it becometh clear and evident which one will emerge like unto pure gold when tested in the assayer's fire, and which one will emerge like unto copper, dull, lusterless, lifeless, and darkened.

order.why: Hear the warning that an unconquered fault can undo apparent attainment.
Keep the severe image of steadfastness and transformed vision attributed.
Read the conditional promise requiring firmness.
shortened: Then know thou that God hath ordained for thee in the Tablet a glorious and noble station if thou remainest firm in His love in such wise that the whisperings of Satan influence not thy heart, for they have appeared in every city in every form.

order.why: Receive the station promised to steadfast souls.
shortened: Verily, for those who are steadfast in this Cause, a mighty station hath been ordained, and they are indeed among the most exalted of creation in the sight of God, thy Lord and the Lord of thy forefathers of old.

order.why: Join recognition with the wine of steadfastness.
shortened: Verily he who hath recognized this Cause and drunk the choice wine of steadfastness - none among all created things can be his equal.

order.why: Clear imagined veils while holding the Covenant.
shortened: Free thine eye from the concealing veils of the people of idle fancies that it may behold the greatest signs, and make firm and steadfast thy steps upon God's covenant and testament that thou mayest become renowned and associated in the assemblage of those drawn nigh.

order.why: Preserve the station through love, knowledge and acceptance.
shortened: Preserve this lofty station in the name of Truth. Blessed art thou for being enkindled with the fire of God's love, illumined by the lights of His knowledge, and for having accepted His Cause and Will.

order.why: Notice the condition attached to incomparable value.
shortened: By the life of God! All that exists and is treasured cannot compare with this lofty, most exalted station, if you succeed in preserving it.

order.why: Keep the direct command to preserve the station.
shortened: Know thou the value of this station and preserve it in the Name of the True One, exalted be His glory.

order.why: Repeat that responsibility at a later personal address.
shortened: Know thou the value of this most exalted and high station and preserve it in the name of Truth.

order.why: Preserve the gift through the divine Name.
Receive protection together with responsibility.
Consider the preciousness of what is to be guarded.
Purify the heart so mercy may dwell there.
Read the surrender of personal will to divine good-pleasure.
Explore contentment with what is revealed.
shortened: Blessed is he who is content with all that hath appeared and been sent down from God, the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful.

order.why: Remain undeterred by rejection.
Ask how awareness of dignity changes the experience of sorrow.
Receive glad tidings that strengthen against discouragement.
Hear the simple assurance not to grieve.
Join freedom from fear with obedience.
Read trust within the assurance of continuing love.
Seek steadfast trust and manifest light.
Keep the reported trust in the Holy Spirit.
shortened: The Spirit of Faith in a Baha'i is very strong. His trust is on the Grace of the Holy Spirit."

order.why: Hear consolation when abasement comes for the divine Name.
Read chains through the inversion of humiliation and glory.
Consider the claim that persecution cannot destroy spiritual dignity.
shortened: Thus it became clear that the divine friends are so glorious that no abasement can follow, no change or alteration possible. Should the entire world unite, seeking to humiliate a single one of God's loved ones, they would fail, for the ultimate outward abasement is martyrdom, yet this martyrdom becomes the cause of eternal glory.

order.why: Keep the difficult claim about trials in love’s path.
Read the martyr’s testimony against worldly sovereignty.
shortened: The day is approaching when kings will seek blessing from his dust and all heads will bow down in his honour, the day when all men will express humility at the revelation of the majesty and grandeur with which the martyrs are invested and all faces will be downcast before the indomitable power of their testimony.

order.why: Receive the address to a martyr’s kin in its grief-filled setting.
shortened: O ye kinsfolk of that martyr! The calamitous field of martyrdom is the path of supreme glory for those who enjoy near access to the court of grandeur. They are brilliant stars shining from the horizon of faith.

order.why: Keep the visitation’s praise attributed to its particular person.
shortened: How excellent was thy deed and how excellent the triumph thou didst achieve through thy Lord's grace, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

order.why: Hear the account of sacrifice together with its priority of present service.
shortened: We beseech God that He may cause new traces to appear in the earth from these holy souls who have attained unto complete sacrifice, inasmuch as sanctified spirits who ascend with perfect detachment and severance have ever been and shall ever be the cause of wondrous manifestations and exalted revelations. Were this servant to attempt to mention the influences of those spirits upon the inner and outer world, he would need to spend long periods expounding this station. By the life of God! If an eye were to be opened and perceive this station, that one would surely sacrifice the entire world, were it in his possession - how much more these weak, frail, worthless lives and these transient, impermanent riches. However, today service to the Cause, meaning its propagation, takes precedence over all else, as may be understood from the blessed Tablets.

order.why: Receive the consolation concerning a completed earthly life.
shortened: That noble soul, praise be to God, attained to all of these gifts. After that he had no need to remain in this world. Assuredly, this is a blessed consummation and an unsurpassed bounty of the All-Merciful.

order.why: Keep the departed soul’s station beyond description.
shortened: He ascended unto a station which no mystic can ever know and which no eloquent one can ever attain. Thus did We ordain for him in the Book of thy Lord.

order.why: Follow transient eminence toward enduring bounty.
shortened: His transient glory was transformed to enduring bounty; his ministry was transferred to eternal and everlasting grace. His eminence and nobility are manifest and evident in the eternal world, and his blessed name remains forever immortal even in this ephemeral world, praised by the people of knowledge.

order.why: Pray in remembrance of Mirza Ibrahim Afnan.
Read companionship across every divine world.
shortened: He hath made thee to be His companion in every one of His worlds, and hath nourished thee with His meeting and presence, so long as His Name, and His Remembrance, and His Kingdom, and His Empire shall endure.

order.why: Let awareness of transience accompany eternal hope.
shortened: The people of Baha behold the passing of all things as they see the sun in the sky. These are the dwellers in the cities of eternity.

order.why: Seek a lasting foundation beyond water and clay.
shortened: And it is clear and evident that this world is the abode of the heedless and its foundation is extremely weak. Surely the people of knowledge and understanding do not set their hearts upon water and clay, but rather they establish a mighty palace, seek a noble man, and take refuge in a strong pillar.

order.why: Ask what one might do that continues to give life.
shortened: (Someone said "I am afraid of hardship and death." He replied:)
Then do something so you never die, but rather become more alive day by day and seek eternal life.

order.why: Retain the promised astonishment and joy of knowing.
Keep longing tied to the station of a particular place.
shortened: Didst thou but know the station of this place, thou wouldst soar with longing and cry out with this Name amongst the worlds.

order.why: Remember the prison as a place transformed by presence.
Receive the blessing of certitude and detachment.
Appreciate what others longed to attain.
shortened: Know thou thy station, for thou hast been honored with that which countless souls have died in their longing for.

order.why: Hear the promise that spiritual worth will become known.
Keep the favor for which holy souls long.
Give shared joy its place in the response to grace.
shortened: In this we take pride among the Supreme Concourse and glory in the Kingdom of Creation. Blessed are we, again blessed are we! Glad tidings to us, again glad tidings to us from this great gift!

order.why: Imagine fellowship as part of the promised bounty.
shortened: But the sincere believers are in the gardens of their Lord's bounty, joyous, in fellowship, finding solace, and giving thanks to their Lord for this abundant gift.

order.why: Read remembrance as a source of others’ gladness.
shortened: O servant of God! Be thou happy, for hearts are gladdened by thy remembrance and souls are delighted by the mention of thee.

order.why: Retain the personal assurance of being remembered.
shortened: O thou who art nigh unto the Divine Threshold! Thou art mentioned in this arena and art well-known and renowned at the Holy Threshold of the Blessed Beauty.
Know thou that thou art mentioned at the Divine Threshold and, like this servant, art well-known and renowned at that Court.

order.why: Hear the hope addressed to Mahmud.
shortened: O Mahmud! Thou art praised and commended at the Threshold of Oneness, and beloved and accepted at the Court of the All-Merciful. I hope that thou mayest be enriched by the praiseworthy station, enter into the realm of manifestation, become aware of the mystery of existence, and attain to the highest summit of ascent.

order.why: Imagine a leader through sympathy and love.
shortened: He will become the leader of all seekers, the sympathetic friend of the believers, the intoxicated one who is entirely possessed by the love of the Beloved.
What sublime state this is! What a luminous station if it is attained.

order.why: Translate the lion’s courage into knowledge and proof.
shortened: O namesake of this servant! It is My ardent hope that thou mayest arise to fulfill the meaning of this name and display the courage, might and majesty of a lion - that is to say, that thou mayest gallop forth in the arena of divine knowledge and, through the power of proof, capture souls.

order.why: Keep the reported dervish episode attributed.
Read inheritance through genuine spiritual relationship.
shortened: Truly this son follows in his father's footsteps, and his relation to that loving one is genuine in spirit and heart - "The son is the secret of his father."

order.why: Receive the particular assurance to a family.
shortened: As you clearly and evidently observe, praise God that He made this family successful in this great Cause, and the results of this gift will endure in that family forever and ever, and no one can deny it or doubt it.

order.why: Keep the reported family’s future regard for a woman’s faith.
shortened: Ere long the whole of her family will consider the faith of that lady as the crown of honor on their heads.

order.why: Read the Hindu visitor’s encounter and family promise in its setting.
shortened: Abdul Baha replied, "Your friends and relatives, nay your father and descendants shall soon glory over this action of yours, that you have overcome such barriers and have come and lived among the disciples of Baha'u'llah.

order.why: Retain the blessing of father, uncle and wider company.
Remember a father alongside steadfast friends.
Keep the obligation to honor a particular person for love of God.
Retain the named Haji Muhammad-Rida’s station.
Read the name recorded beyond ordinary sight.
shortened: He is, verily, of the people of Baha, whose name hath been inscribed in a Tablet from which the eyes are barred.

order.why: Receive the prospect of a future station.
shortened: He shall assuredly find himself in the All-Highest Prospect, and shall soon find himself in the most exalted station - the station wherein shine forth the lights of the countenance of the Youth. Verily, it is a noble station.

order.why: Hear glad tidings addressed to the chosen.
shortened: So glad tidings to you, O chosen ones! And blessed are you, O noble ones! And joy be unto you, O chiefs, from the Abha Kingdom!

order.why: Link future disclosure with arising to serve.
shortened: Whosoever hath attained this supreme honor in this Day is mentioned among the inhabitants of the most exalted Paradise in the Book of Names, and the Pens of the Kingdom of Utterance are unable to describe his station. God will soon make manifest the stations of those who have turned to Him and arisen to serve His Cause.

order.why: Recognize youthful recipients’ spiritual dignity.
shortened: And when it reacheth thee, take it with the hand of power, for those who have taken the Tablet of God in those days are nobles in the Concourse on High and great ones in the realms of immortality and eloquent ones concerning the Command, even though they be but youths upon the earth.

order.why: Keep Covenant, encounter and reunion together.
Read friendship through belonging to the Most Great Name.
shortened: You are the friends of the Ancient Beauty, may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones, and you are the companions of the Most Great Name, may my being be offered up for His chosen ones. You are mentioned in the Kingdom of Sanctification and renowned in the Heaven of Unity.

order.why: Give thanks for being numbered among the few.
Receive the testimony of books past and future.
Keep the people of Baha within the divine Tablet.
Join earthly name with heavenly servitude.
shortened: In the Supreme Concourse you have been named the servants of Baha, and in the earthly kingdom you are mentioned by His name.

order.why: Remember the first recipients of guidance.
shortened: At the beginning of the dawning of the Light of the Horizons they accepted and were confirmed in the greatest guidance. They were ever intoxicated from the overflowing cup and made alive by the sweet fragrance of that musk-diffusing tress. The men were trusted servants and the women were manifestations of the evident light.

order.why: Read the signature and headline as images of recognition.
shortened: Thus, blessed are those souls who are the headline of this book and the royal signature of this decree of the Most Great Name.

order.why: Retain the declaration of names honored by nations.
Keep the blessing upon the people of Baha.
shortened: By God! They are the people of Baha among all creatures.
Upon them be the glory of God and the glory of all the worlds.

order.why: Hear the prayer of heavenly company for a sincere servant.
Receive the Bab’s promise of the gardens of justice.
Read present belonging within the promise of Paradise.
shortened: And they who have believed, these dwell in the highest Paradise, and are now numbered among the blessed in the Abha Paradise.

order.why: Receive the angels’ blessing.
shortened: They, verily, are the people of Baha amidst earth and heaven, upon whom the angels near unto God do send their blessings.

order.why: Link the received Tablet with being remembered.
Retain the warning beside the blessing.
shortened: Blessed is he who has attained, and woe unto the most lost ones who have deprived themselves of this glorious station.

order.why: Hear remembrance at evening and dawn.
Read the All-Merciful’s remembrance of a sincere soul.
Receive attainment as a sufficient bestowal.
Receive greetings for those who cast aside idle fancies.
shortened: Convey My greetings to My loved ones who have cast away idle fancies and held fast to My Self-Subsisting Name, through which, when it appeared, the atoms proclaimed: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Lord of the Exalted Throne!

order.why: Give thanks for turning and receiving the Tablet.
shortened: Joy be unto thee for having turned towards the Countenance when most of the servants turned away from it, and blessed art thou for having attained the Tablet of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

order.why: Keep the name recorded by the Ancient of Days.
shortened: By God's life! Such a one is of the people of Baha who hath been inscribed by the Pen of the Ancient of Days in the Books of God.

order.why: Join turning with the image of the received cup.
shortened: Such are accounted among the most exalted of creation in My mighty Book.
Blessed art thou for having turned unto Me, and taken, and drunk the choice wine in My glorious, mighty Name.

order.why: Retain the stated value of recognizing the Most Great Name.
shortened: Verily, he who hath attained unto this Most Great Name is accounted among the most exalted of peoples in the perspicuous Book.

order.why: Extend the blessing to fellow witnesses.
Hear the honor offered to those who have attained.
shortened: Verily, those who have attained today, they are honored servants upon whom the Concourse on High pray and whom the Tongue of Grandeur doth mention in this praiseworthy station.

order.why: Keep earthly affairs from obscuring the opportunity.
shortened: This is a Day wherein man is empowered to gain everlasting stations, eternal bounties, and perpetual remembrance. Blessed is the soul whom the affairs of men have not debarred from the ocean of grace nor held back from the Sun of Truth.

order.why: Return to thanksgiving at the threshold of the loving Lord.
shortened: Render ye thanks unto God, inasmuch as in the Day of the advent of the Kingdom ye have drawn so nigh unto His court and are so greatly favoured at the Threshold of the loving Lord.

order.why: Receive bounty as a great trust.
shortened: O ye two servants of the divine Threshold! The limitless bounties of God have embraced your lives so that ye have became the bearers of a great trust from God.

order.why: Read purity and unity as distinguishing the enduring life.
Let praise recognize piety and fidelity in others.
shortened: O my God! Even if I were to speak with an eloquent tongue and let loose the reins of expression in a vast and expansive field, I would still fall short of offering the praise, tributes, thanks and glorification due to Thee for the bounty and bestowal Thou hast granted me. For Thou, O my God, hast through Thy all-encompassing power created loved ones whom Thou hast guided to the fountain of the Salsabil of faithfulness, whose eyes Thou hast illumined with the light of guidance, and whom Thou hast made to be mines of piety and dawning-places of the lights of fidelity.

order.why: Pray for the portion of those undeterred by human conditions.
Describe a believer through concrete humility and service.
shortened: And this human being, O my Merciful Lord, is one who has believed in Thee and Thy signs, turned toward Thy Kingdom, shown humility before Thy Might, been illumined by Thy radiance, sought victory through Thy holy angels, drawn from the ocean of Thy knowledge, been enlightened by the dawning-place of Thy subsistence, arisen to serve Thee, sought Thy servitude, persisted in Thy worship, spoke Thy praise, showed humility to Thy loved ones, and submission to Thy chosen ones, and wished to be as dust beneath the feet of Thy servants.

order.why: Join inherited connection with responsibility to arise.
Give thanks for the ability to render service.
Let knowing the station lead to aiding the Cause.
shortened: We have remembered thee in a Tablet that crieth out between earth and heaven: "O people of Baha! By God, ye have attained unto that which none before you hath attained. Know ye your station, then aid your Lord, the Most Merciful, the Compassionate. Blessed is he that heareth and seeth, and woe unto the deniers."

order.why: Read knowledge and service as the brightness of a star.
shortened: Blessed are those souls who in the Day of His manifestation attained unto the knowledge of God and arose to serve Him. Such souls are accounted before God as stars in a wondrous heaven.

order.why: Connect hearing, favor, service and praise.
Turn nearness toward guiding others.
shortened: And he who draws near is verily among His chosen ones amidst His creation and His guides amongst His servants. Upon him shall pray the Concourse on High and the dwellers of the Kingdom of Names, and then those who have arisen to aid the Cause of God in the realm of creation.

order.why: Keep exalted servants calling others toward God.
